admin-panel-session-expired.name: Admin Panel Session Expired
admin-panel-session-expired.description: Admin (or any browser with a stale/absent session) requests a /panel/* route other than /panel/login without a valid staff session. admin-proposal-edit.name: Admin Proposal Edit
admin-proposal-edit.description: Edit an existing business proposal. Includes the Det. técnico tab where each requirement can be linked to commercial items (linked_item_ids checkboxes) for item-requirement traceability. The technical editor renders its sections collapsed by default (headers with counts; bodies mount on expand via technical-section-toggle-<key>) and the per-requirement link grids live behind a 'Vincular alcance/ítems' disclosure (technical-req-links-toggle); the JSON sub-tab mounts only when opened.

admin-proposal-delete.name: Admin Proposal Delete
admin-proposal-delete.description: Delete an existing business proposal from /panel/proposals. A confirm modal requires typing 'DELETE'; on success the list refreshes and a success toast shows; on 409 (proposal linked to a launched project via ProjectPhase on_delete=PROTECT) the proposal stays and an error toast surfaces the backend message.

admin-proposal-delete-from-client.name: Admin Proposal Delete From Client
admin-proposal-delete-from-client.description: From /panel/clients, expand a client row and delete a specific linked proposal. A confirm modal requires typing 'DELETE'; on success the client detail is refetched (proposal disappears) and a success toast shows; on 409 (linked to a launched project) the proposal stays and an error toast shows.

admin-proposal-send.name: Admin Proposal Send
admin-proposal-send.description: Send a proposal to a client via email from the proposals list (actions modal) or from the edit page. The email body now interpolates the editable email_intro field from the proposal and the commercial PDF is attached automatically. Backend returns email_delivery: {ok, reason, detail}; when ok=false, the panel surfaces a red toast with the reason (placeholder_email, template_disabled, send_failed) instead of generic success.
admin-proposal-send.knownGaps: The server-side PDF-attachment side effect on send is backend-only and not asserted at the UI layer.

admin-proposal-multi-send.name: Admin Proposal Multi Send
admin-proposal-multi-send.description: From /panel/proposals/:id/edit click the lightning-bolt button → ProposalActionsModal → 'Enviar varias propuestas como un solo correo'. The ProposalMultiSendModal opens showing all proposals of the same client grouped by status (Borradores / Enviadas-Vistas-Negociación / Expiradas). The current proposal is pre-selected and locked. Admin selects ≥2 proposals (max 10) and clicks 'Enviar N propuestas' → POST /api/proposals/:id/send-multi/ sends a single email with one PDF attachment per proposal and applies per-proposal side effects (draft→sent + reminders, expired→reopen + extend expires_at, sent/viewed/negotiating→resend timers). Success shows a toast with the count.

admin-proposal-resend.name: Admin Proposal Resend
admin-proposal-resend.description: Resend an already-sent proposal via 'Re-enviar' from the actions modal. Confirmation dialog → POST /proposals/:id/resend/ keeps existing expires_at, resets sent_at and reminder timers, and returns email_delivery. The panel toast surfaces success or failure with the reason.

admin-proposal-reopen-from-expired.name: Admin Proposal Reopen From Expired
admin-proposal-reopen-from-expired.description: Recover an expired proposal by extending expires_at to a future date from /panel/proposals/:id/edit (General tab) or via the JSON re-import panel. The serializer no longer blocks re-saving when expires_at is unchanged, and ProposalService.reopen_if_unexpired auto-reverts status from 'expired' to 'viewed' (when view_count > 0) or 'sent', logging an 'Auto-reopened from expired…' entry in ProposalChangeLog. Covers both PATCH /proposals/:id/update/ and PUT /proposals/:id/update-from-json/ paths.

admin-proposal-update-from-json.name: Admin Proposal Update From JSON
admin-proposal-update-from-json.description: Re-import a complete JSON payload over an existing proposal from /panel/proposals/:id/edit. Pastes/uploads JSON → PUT /proposals/:id/update-from-json/ replaces metadata and section content_json. Different from admin-proposal-create-from-json (creation): targets an existing proposal id, supports keeping expires_at unchanged on expired proposals, and surfaces unknown-key warnings.
knownGaps: Happy path only; unknown-key warnings surfacing and keep-expires_at-on-expired branch unasserted (2026-07 audit).

proposal-resolved-notice-suppression.name: Proposal Resolved Notice Suppression
proposal-resolved-notice-suppression.description: When a proposal is in a resolved status (accepted, rejected or finished), the public view at /proposal/:uuid hides time-sensitive / urgency notices that no longer make sense after the client's decision is settled: the expiration countdown badge (ExpirationBadge), the limited-time discount banner (Investment.vue .discount-banner) and the hosting tier discount badges. While the proposal is still open (sent/viewed) those notices keep showing. The `expired` status is handled separately by the expired-state banner.
knownGaps: Documented-only (expectedSpecs 0): no dedicated Playwright spec yet. Suggested e2e/proposal/proposal-resolved-notice-suppression.spec.js mocking GET /api/proposals/:uuid/ with status 'accepted'/'finished' and an expires_at + discount_percent set, asserting the ExpirationBadge and .discount-banner are absent; and a control case with status 'sent' asserting they render. Unit-level coverage exists in frontend/test/components/Investment.test.js (resolved-status notice suppression).

proposal-hosting-plan-terms.name: Proposal Hosting Plan Terms
proposal-hosting-plan-terms.description: In the Investment section of the public proposal (/proposal/:uuid) the hosting plan shows three payment-frequency tiers (annual 40% / semiannual 20% / quarterly 10%; month-to-month is not offered, minimum commitment is quarterly) and a '1 free month of hosting' gift bucket (billing starts on the 1st of the month, at least one free month). The tier cards match the width of the coverage cards above them. The renewal conditions (for each renewal year from the second year the cost grows by Colombian SMLMV increase % + a fixed 8% over the previous year) render ONLY in the downloadable PDF, NOT in the web view. Tiers and the free-month bucket render in both the web view and the PDF, in Spanish and English. Hosting numbers (80% default, tier discounts) come from the BusinessProposal model fields.
knownGaps: Documented-only (expectedSpecs 0): no dedicated Playwright spec yet. Suggested e2e/proposal/proposal-hosting-plan-terms.spec.js mocking GET /api/proposals/:uuid/ with a hostingPlan carrying the annual tier + renewalNote + freeMonths, asserting the three tiers (annual 40%), the free-month bucket render (ES and EN), and that the 'Renovaciones' block does NOT render in the web view (it is PDF-only). Unit coverage exists in frontend/test/components/Investment.test.js (hosting: annual tier, free month, renewal). PDF rendering (backend/content/services/proposal_pdf_service.py) has no automated assertion.

The draft→sent transition is delegated to ProposalService.send_proposal so the client email is dispatched and Huey reminders are scheduled (defense-in-depth — same behavior as the dedicated 'Enviar al Cliente' button). admin-proposal-defaults-config.name: Admin Proposal Defaults Config
admin-proposal-defaults-config.description: Manage default section configurations for new proposals (ES/EN), with save and reset-to-hardcoded. Saving sections states the version loaded, so a snapshot left open across another write is refused instead of rewinding the stored defaults.

admin-email-templates-config.name: Admin Email Templates Config
admin-email-templates-config.description: Manage email template text customization with category filter, inline editing, HTML preview, active toggle, and reset to defaults.

admin-proposal-scorecard.description: View a 1-10 completeness scorecard with blockers before sending a proposal.

admin-daily-pipeline-digest.name: Admin Daily Pipeline Digest
admin-daily-pipeline-digest.description: Daily email digest with viewed yesterday, inactive, and expiring proposals.
knownGaps: Backend-only, covered by backend unit tests

proposal-payment-plan-closing.description: Display payment plan milestones near the accept button in the closing section.

proposal-section-onboarding.description: Per-section spotlight onboarding tutorials (Investment, Requirements, Executive Investment) that trigger on first visit to each section.

proposal-technical-view.description: Client opens public proposal with ?mode=technical to read the technical document (synthetic panels from technical_document) plus closing, and jumps to a section from the cover index.

platform-login.name: Platform Login
platform-login.description: Client or admin authenticates via JWT login form. Routes to /platform/verify (first login), /platform/complete-profile (profile incomplete), or /platform/dashboard (onboarded).

platform-verify-onboarding.name: Platform Verify & Onboarding
platform-verify-onboarding.description: First-login OTP verification with 6-digit code input, new password set, and role-aware redirect: clients land on /platform/documents, admins on the dashboard (via complete-profile when pending).

platform-client-document-portal.name: Platform Client Document Portal
platform-client-document-portal.description: Client lands on /platform/documents after first login: main contract plus annexes render and each can be downloaded as PDF.

platform-client-email-validation.name: Platform Client Email Validation
platform-client-email-validation.description: Client validates their account email via a 6-digit OTP sent from the documents portal before signing is unlocked.

platform-client-document-sign.name: Platform Client Document Sign
platform-client-document-sign.description: Client accepts/signs the main document via click-to-accept (gated on a verified email); the signature is recorded and the team is notified.

platform-complete-profile.name: Platform Complete Profile
platform-complete-profile.description: Mandatory profile completion form with company, phone, cedula, date of birth, gender, education level, and optional avatar upload. Middleware gates dashboard access until completed.

platform-kanban-board.name: Platform Kanban Board
platform-kanban-board.description: 3-column kanban board (Por hacer, En progreso, En revisión) with collapsible Completados checklist. HTML5 drag & drop between columns, checkmark to complete, card detail modal with comments and history timeline. Cards are labeled and filterable by their proposal scope item (vista/componente/funcionalidad) with an 'Sin agrupar' bucket. Admin has full control; client can only approve in_review cards.

platform-proposal-auto-onboarding.name: Proposal Acceptance Auto-Onboarding
platform-proposal-auto-onboarding.description: When a proposal becomes accepted (client response or admin inline), an async task provisions the client's platform project: creates the project/phase, mirrors the functional_requirements items as ProjectScopeItem rows, and upserts Kanban Requirement cards from the technical_document, linked to their scope item. Idempotent (runs once) and preserves client-owned Kanban state on re-sync. Backend-triggered; not a browser E2E journey.

platform-dashboard.name: Platform Dashboard
platform-dashboard.description: Admin dashboard shows KPI cards (active/pending/inactive clients), recent clients table, and upcoming modules. Client dashboard shows profile summary and upcoming modules.

platform-sidebar-navigation.name: Platform Sidebar Navigation
platform-sidebar-navigation.description: Left sidebar layout with collapsible navigation (Principal, Proyectos, Administración sections), mobile hamburger drawer, theme toggle (light/dark), profile link, and logout.

platform-project-list.name: Platform Project List
platform-project-list.description: Admin sees all projects with status filters (Todos/Activos/Pausados/Completados/Archivados) and create button. Client sees only their assigned projects. Card grid with progress bars and estimated dates.

platform-project-detail.name: Platform Project Detail
platform-project-detail.description: Project detail hub with stats row (progress, client, dates), module cards (Tablero active, others 'Próximamente'), and admin edit modal for name, description, status, dates.

platform-unified-board.name: Platform Unified Board
platform-unified-board.description: Cross-project view showing active requirement cards (todo/in_progress/in_review) grouped by project with summary pills and links to per-project boards.

platform-admin-client-list.name: Platform Admin Client List
platform-admin-client-list.description: Admin-only client management table with invite modal (create + send credentials), status filters (Todos/Onboarded/Pendientes/Inactivos), search, resend invite, and deactivate actions.

platform-admin-client-detail.name: Platform Admin Client Detail
platform-admin-client-detail.description: Admin-only client detail page with profile card, edit form (name, company, phone, active toggle), quick actions (resend invite, deactivate/reactivate).

platform-profile-edit.name: Platform Profile Edit
platform-profile-edit.description: View and update personal profile fields (name, company, phone, cedula, DOB, gender, education) with avatar display and role badge.

platform-admin-project-create.name: Platform Admin Project Create
platform-admin-project-create.description: Admin creates a new project via modal form with name, description, client selector, start date, and estimated end date.

platform-kanban-card-comments.name: Platform Kanban Card Comments
platform-kanban-card-comments.description: Add public or internal (admin-only) comments on requirement cards via the card detail modal. Internal comments marked with amber border and 'Interno' label.

proposal-view-paste-rendering.name: Proposal View Paste Mode Rendering
proposal-view-paste-rendering.description: Client views paste-mode sections rendered as RawContentSection with markdown in a styled card, while form-mode sections render structured Vue components.

proposal-sticky-bar-accept.name: Proposal Sticky Bar Accept (ARCHIVED)
proposal-sticky-bar-accept.description: ARCHIVED — ProposalResponseButtons component removed from production. Acceptance handled via ProposalClosing section buttons.
knownGaps: Feature removed from production. Flow archived.

platform-change-requests.name: Platform Change Requests
platform-change-requests.description: Client creates change requests for a project. Admin evaluates (approve/reject/needs clarification) with estimated cost and time. Both roles can comment. Per-project view at /platform/projects/:id/changes and unified cross-project view at /platform/changes.

platform-bug-reports.name: Platform Bug Reports
platform-bug-reports.description: Both roles report bugs with severity, steps to reproduce, expected/actual behavior, device/browser, screenshot. Admin evaluates with status changes and responses. Per-project view at /platform/projects/:id/bugs and unified cross-project view at /platform/bugs.

platform-deliverables.name: Platform Deliverables
platform-deliverables.description: Admin uploads deliverables (designs, documents, APKs, credentials) with version history. Client downloads files. Per-project view at /platform/projects/:id/deliverables and unified cross-project view at /platform/deliverables.

platform-hosting-subscription.name: Platform Hosting Subscription
platform-hosting-subscription.description: On the project payments page the client sees a per-phase hosting cost table (one row per project phase + total) with frequency pills (quarterly/semiannual/annual — annual carries the biggest discount; month-to-month is not offered, minimum commitment is quarterly) that recompute the total live, and activates the subscription at the chosen frequency. The subscription bills the sum of all started phases; future-dated phases join later prorated. Billing always starts on the 1st of a calendar month and the client gets a free hosting period from project delivery until that first billing date (always at least one full month), so the first charge is deferred to the 1st rather than charged on activation day. While the subscription is pending the client can still change the frequency (pills stay editable, the first payment realigns); it locks once the first payment settles (table becomes display-only). Card is the only payment method. After activation the client registers a card (see platform-hosting-card-setup) for automatic recurring billing. Admin sees subscription status and stored-card info. Netflix-style active state shows the next automatic renewal date. Per-project view at /platform/projects/:id/payments and unified view at /platform/payments.
knownGaps: The free-month gift (first charge deferred to the 1st, >= 1 month free) and always-bill-on-the-1st alignment are backend date rules, unit-tested in accounts/tests/test_hosting_multiphase.py (TestFirstBillingDate, TestAnnualPlan); no dedicated UI assertion. The annual pill select + recompute + activate is now covered.

platform-hosting-card-setup.name: Platform Hosting Card Setup (3DS)
platform-hosting-card-setup.description: Client registers a card once for automatic hosting billing. From the project payments page the client opens the card modal, enters card data, and the card is tokenized into a Wompi payment source. When the card requires 3D Secure, an authentication flow runs (browser-info/fingerprint hidden iframes, then a visible bank challenge iframe) polled every 2s until the source is AVAILABLE. On success the card is stored on the subscription and the first open payment is charged. The same flow handles 'Cambiar tarjeta'. A failed payment can be retried manually with the stored card. E2E mocks Wompi + 3DS (the challenge iframe is :srcdoc, no live sandbox): the AVAILABLE happy path and the PENDING → 3DS challenge path.

platform-hosting-card-delete.name: Platform Hosting Card Delete
platform-hosting-card-delete.description: From the project payments page, when a card is on file, the client sees an 'Eliminar tarjeta' button next to 'Cambiar tarjeta'. Clicking it opens a confirmation modal warning that automatic billing will be disabled. On confirm, DELETE /api/accounts/projects/:id/subscription/card/remove/ best-effort deletes the Wompi payment source and clears the stored card fields on the subscription, so has_payment_source becomes false and the 'Activa el cobro automático / Registrar tarjeta' state reappears. The button is hidden for admins and for archived subscriptions.
platform-hosting-card-delete.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-23 (QA campaign round 5): confirm delete restoring the register state, cancel without API call, and the in-modal error branch over mocked API.

platform-notifications.name: Platform Notifications
platform-notifications.description: In-app notification center with unread count badge in sidebar, filter tabs (all/unread/read), mark-all-read, and click-to-navigate deep links to the relevant project module (board, changes, bugs, deliverables).

platform-kanban-json-upload.name: Platform Kanban JSON Upload
platform-kanban-json-upload.description: Admin bulk-creates requirements by uploading a JSON file. Includes downloadable example template. Each requirement has title, description, configuration (roles/permissions), and flow (user flow). POST /api/accounts/projects/:projectId/deliverables/:deliverableId/requirements/bulk/.

platform-requirement-client-review.name: Platform Requirement Client Review
platform-requirement-client-review.description: Client reviews completed requirements from the Kanban board. Clicking a done card shows three options: Approve (marks as accepted), Request Change (navigates to change requests with pre-filled data), or Report Bug (navigates to bugs with pre-filled data).

admin-document-list.name: Admin Document List
admin-document-list.description: View the list of admin documents with title, status, client association. Per-row actions are collapsed into a single 'Acciones' (kebab) icon that opens the DocumentActionsSheet modal listing each action with its own icon: edit content, rename, move to folder, send by email, download PDF, copy markdown, duplicate, delete. The same single-icon + modal pattern is used on every breakpoint (centered modal on desktop, bottom-sheet on mobile). Navigate to create or edit pages. Each document persists a template style (Amigable/Profesional, field template_style); the DocumentActionsSheet download action is split into two rows, 'Descargar PDF · Amigable' and 'Descargar PDF · Profesional', so either PDF style can be generated without opening the editor.

admin-document-gallery.name: Admin Document Gallery View
admin-document-gallery.description: Toggle between list and gallery views on /panel/documents via the 'Lista'/'Galería' segmented control (data-testid doc-view-list / doc-view-grid). Gallery renders one card per document with a sanitized markdown mini-preview (content_excerpt), status badge overlay, client + date, up to 2 tag chips with a +N tooltip, and the same kebab 'Acciones' opening DocumentActionsSheet. Subfolder cards render first with dashed borders and act as drag-and-drop targets. The chosen mode persists in localStorage (projectapp-documents-view-mode); default is 'list'. On mobile the gallery grid is always the view. Same as the list view, the DocumentActionsSheet 'Acciones' modal offers both 'Descargar PDF · Amigable' and 'Descargar PDF · Profesional' rows, matching each document's persisted template style.

admin-document-create.name: Admin Document Create
admin-document-create.description: Create a new admin document via Markdown paste mode or file upload mode, with title, optional client association, and live preview.
admin-document-create.knownGaps: Spec covers paste mode only; "Cargar Archivo" upload mode (POST /api/documents/upload-markdown/), cover toggles and template-style selection untested (2026-07-16 audit).

admin-document-edit.name: Admin Document Edit
admin-document-edit.description: Edit an existing admin document, change content, update status, download as PDF, and copy/paste the markdown content via the toolbar buttons above the textarea. A 'Amigable'/'Profesional' segmented switch (data-testid doc-style-friendly / doc-style-professional) above the markdown preview selects the document's persisted template_style and re-themes the live preview (class markdown-preview--professional toggles on the preview root). The 'Descargar PDF' split button offers both 'Descargar · Amigable' and 'Descargar · Profesional' so either PDF style can be downloaded regardless of the switch's current position.

admin-document-folders.name: Admin Document Folders and Tags
admin-document-folders.description: Organize admin documents with folders and tags: root-folder sidebar navigation, tag filter chips, and folder/tag management modals. In the folder manager modal, the 'Nueva carpeta' form's 'Dentro de:' parent selector defaults to the currently active folder, so creating a folder while standing inside a child folder pre-selects that folder as the parent (still changeable to any folder or root).

admin-document-folder-hierarchy.name: Admin Document Folder Hierarchy
admin-document-folder-hierarchy.description: Navigate nested document folders: root-only sidebar, subfolder rows inside the table, breadcrumb navigation above the table, and drag-to-nest re-parenting of folders.

admin-admin-management.name: Admin User Management
admin-admin-management.description: Manage admin users: list with status filters (All/Active/Inactive), invite new admin via modal, view and deactivate existing admins.

admin-email-deliverability.name: Admin Email Deliverability Dashboard
admin-email-deliverability.description: Dashboard tracking email send/delivery/bounce rates for all proposal-related automated emails. Accessible from /panel/proposals/email-deliverability.

admin-view-map.name: Admin View Map
admin-view-map.description: Open the panel route inventory, filter grouped views, and copy route references for support and QA communication. Includes the interactive map mode: Lista/Mapa toggle, module cards with stats, drill-down into curated sub-modules, and deep-linking via ?viewMode=map&module=<id>. Ships seeded filter tabs (Admin, Público, Cliente, Dashboards, Configuración) and a Configuración section that persists the default view mode and default filters in the ViewMapSettings backend singleton; ?viewMode= overrides the configured default and localStorage no longer persists the last-used mode.
knownGaps: Configuración default-filters autosave (debounced PATCH + toast) and default-filters application on open are unit-covered only (2026-07 audit).
Saved-tab CRUD (create/rename/delete) unasserted on view_map; shared ProposalFilterTabs component is exercised in proposals specs (2026-07 audit).

public-landing-software.name: Landing Software Development
public-landing-software.description: View the custom software development landing page with hero, features, CTA, and contact form section.

public-landing-apps.name: Landing App Development
public-landing-apps.description: View the mobile app development landing page with hero, features, CTA, and contact form section.

platform-collection-accounts-list.name: Platform Collection Accounts List
platform-collection-accounts-list.description: Browse collection accounts at /platform/collection-accounts: table, filters (admin), new draft (admin), Open links to detail.

platform-collection-account-detail.name: Platform Collection Account Detail
platform-collection-account-detail.description: View a single collection account: amounts, line items, Download PDF; admin Issue / Mark paid / Cancel when applicable.

platform-project-collection-accounts.name: Platform Project Collection Accounts
platform-project-collection-accounts.description: List collection accounts scoped to a project at /platform/projects/:id/collection-accounts with links to detail.

platform-deliverable-detail.name: Platform Deliverable Detail
platform-deliverable-detail.description: View deliverable detail at /platform/projects/:id/deliverables/:deliverableId: linked proposal PDFs, main file, epic, board link; admin attachment upload.

admin-proposal-contract-generate.name: Admin Proposal Contract Generate
admin-proposal-contract-generate.description: Admin generates a development contract from the proposal edit Documents tab. Two modes: 'Contrato por defecto' (fill contractor/client params form with auto-populated company settings) or 'Contrato personalizado' (paste/upload custom Markdown). Submit calls save-and-negotiate API. Visible only when proposal status is negotiating/accepted/rejected.

admin-proposal-contract-edit.name: Admin Proposal Contract Edit
admin-proposal-contract-edit.description: Admin edits an existing contract's parameters via 'Editar parámetros' button in the Documents tab. Modal opens pre-filled with saved params. Submit calls contract update API.

admin-proposal-contract-download.name: Admin Proposal Contract Download
admin-proposal-contract-download.description: Admin downloads contract PDF (final version) or draft PDF from the Documents tab. Download links visible only when contract has been generated.

admin-proposal-documents-manage.name: Admin Proposal Documents Manage
admin-proposal-documents-manage.description: Admin uploads additional documents (otrosí, legal annex, client document, other with custom label) to a proposal via the Documents tab. Lists existing documents with type badges. Delete non-generated documents.

admin-proposal-document-preview.name: Admin Proposal Document Preview
admin-proposal-document-preview.description: From the Documents tab of the proposal edit page, admin clicks the eye icon next to a document. A modal opens previewing the file inline — PDF (rendered in iframe) or image (via tag), gated by frontend/utils/filePreview.js (isPdfUrl / isImageUrl / canPreviewFile). Non-previewable files (Word/Excel/etc.) keep only the existing download action. Modal is dismissed via close button or backdrop click.

admin-proposal-documents-send.name: Admin Proposal Documents Send (SUPERSEDED)
admin-proposal-documents-send.description: SUPERSEDED Apr 22 2026: The 'Enviar al cliente' section was removed from the Documents tab. Documents are now attached from the Correos tab via 'Adjuntar desde Documentos' (see admin-proposal-attach-from-documents). The spec admin-proposal-documents-send.spec.js was deleted. This flow entry is kept for historical traceability only.
knownGaps: Flow superseded — 'Enviar al cliente' section removed from the Documents tab on 2026-04-22; replaced by admin-proposal-attach-from-documents via the Correos tab. Entry retained for historical traceability.

admin-send-branded-email.name: Admin Send Branded Email (Negotiating)
admin-send-branded-email.description: Admin sends a branded marketing email from the Correos tab of a proposal in negotiating/accepted/rejected status. Composer with draggable sections (per-section Markdown toggle), file attachments, server-rendered preview of the real branded template (POST /api/emails/preview/ with proposal_id, sandboxed iframe), paginated history. Endpoints: POST /api/proposals/:id/branded-email/send/, GET /api/proposals/:id/branded-email/defaults/, GET /api/proposals/:id/branded-email/history/.

admin-send-proposal-email.name: Admin Send Proposal Email (Sent+)
admin-send-proposal-email.description: Admin sends a proposal email from the Enviar correo tab once the proposal is sent or beyond. Each send writes ProposalChangeLog with EMAIL_SENT change type and updates last_activity_at. Reuses the same composer UI as branded email via mode prop (per-section Markdown toggle + server-rendered preview via POST /api/emails/preview/). Endpoints: POST /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/send/, GET /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/defaults/, GET /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/history/, POST /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/markdown-attachment/.

admin-proposal-attach-from-documents.name: Admin Proposal — Adjuntar desde Documentos
admin-proposal-attach-from-documents.description: From the Correos tab of the proposal edit page, admin clicks 'Adjuntar desde Documentos'. A modal opens listing all available documents: contract PDF + draft (if contract exists), commercial PDF, technical PDF, and any uploaded proposal_documents. Admin selects one or more items and clicks 'Adjuntar (N)'. Selected refs appear as emerald badges below the attachments block. On send, the POST body includes a doc_refs JSON field with the resolved refs. Sending is handled by admin-send-branded-email / admin-send-proposal-email; this flow covers only the selection UX.

admin-diagnostic-attach-from-documents.name: Admin Diagnostic — Adjuntar desde Documentos
admin-diagnostic-attach-from-documents.description: From the Correos tab of the diagnostic edit page, admin clicks 'Adjuntar desde Documentos'. A modal opens listing: NDA final + draft (if NDA generated), the 3 static MD templates fetched from GET /api/diagnostic-templates/, and any uploaded diagnostic attachments. Admin selects and confirms. Selected refs appear as emerald badges in the composer. On send, POST body includes doc_refs. This flow covers only the selection UX.

platform-project-data-model.name: Platform Project Data Model
platform-project-data-model.description: Admin uploads a JSON data model for a project (copy/download template, file upload or paste, validate, submit). Both roles see the entity table (name, description, keyFields, relationship). Empty state and error/retry state.

public-privacy-policy.name: Privacy Policy Page
public-privacy-policy.description: View the public privacy policy page with localized content (ES/EN).

public-terms-conditions.name: Terms and Conditions Page
public-terms-conditions.description: View the public terms and conditions page with localized content (ES/EN).

admin-blog-linkedin-connect.name: Admin Blog LinkedIn Connect
admin-blog-linkedin-connect.description: Admin connects LinkedIn account from blog post edit page via OAuth 2.0 popup flow. Popup opens at authorization URL, user authenticates, /auth/linkedin/callback exchanges code via POST /api/linkedin/callback/, popup notifies opener via postMessage, edit page updates to show connected profile.
knownGaps: OAuth popup requires real LinkedIn credentials — E2E should mock the callback URL and API endpoints

admin-blog-linkedin-publish.name: Admin Blog LinkedIn Publish
admin-blog-linkedin-publish.description: Admin fills LinkedIn summary (EN preferred or ES, ≤1300 chars), selects language (defaults to English — US market focus), clicks 'Publicar en LinkedIn' → POST /api/blog/admin/:id/publish-linkedin/. Success message renders. Publish button disabled when summary is empty. Last publish timestamp shown after success.

admin-qr-cards.name: Admin QR Cards
admin-qr-cards.description: Admin creates QR cards (name required, destination URL optional) that get a UUID short link (/t/:uuid/) redirecting to the configurable destination. QR always encodes the short link, never the destination. Download modal customizes foreground/background color and transparency client-side, without persisting the choice.

admin-blog-publish-mode.name: Admin Blog Publish Mode
admin-blog-publish-mode.description: From the blog edit page, admin selects how the post should be published via three radio options: 'Borrador' (draft), 'Publicar ahora' (immediate), or 'Programar' (scheduled). Selecting 'Programar' reveals a datetime input for publish_scheduled_for. If the STORED schedule (published_at at hydration time) is in the past, an amber overdue banner ([data-test='scheduled-overdue-banner']) warns that the safety-net Huey task will publish on the next run; the banner is not live input validation. The mode is computed by frontend/utils/blogPublishMode.js (resolveBlogPublishMode → { mode, scheduledIso, overdue }) and submitted to the blog update endpoint.
admin-blog-publish-mode.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 4): draft/schedule reveal, past-date overdue banner, scheduled hydration and the publish-now PATCH payload over mocked API.

admin-blog-overdue-detection.name: Admin Blog Overdue Schedule Safety-Net
admin-blog-overdue-detection.description: Backend Huey periodic task scans BlogPost rows where publish_scheduled_for is in the past but the post is still unpublished, then publishes them automatically (and triggers the LinkedIn auto-publish if connected). The management command publish_blog_post.py is a manual escape hatch for the same logic. No browser interaction.
knownGaps: Backend-only safety-net for missed schedules. Covered by backend/content/tests/tasks/test_blog_publish_guards.py; no E2E spec applies.

admin-standalone-email-composer.name: Admin Standalone Email Composer
admin-standalone-email-composer.description: Admin composes and sends branded emails from /panel/emails (not tied to a proposal). Page-level tabs (Redactar / Historial / Valores por defecto, deep-linked via ?tab=). Redactar: draggable sections with per-section Markdown toggle, file attachments, server-rendered preview of the real branded template (POST /api/emails/preview/, sandboxed iframe). Historial: paginated email history. Uses standalone endpoints: emails/send/, emails/preview/, emails/defaults/, emails/history/.
admin-standalone-email-composer.knownGaps: Spec does not exercise: add/remove/drag-reorder sections, send-error path, history entry expand/collapse, "Cargar más" pagination. Attachments split out to admin-standalone-email-attachments (2026-07-16 audit).

admin-standalone-email-defaults.name: Admin Standalone Email Defaults Config
admin-standalone-email-defaults.description: Admin configures the standalone email composer defaults from the 'Valores por defecto' tab of /panel/emails (deep-linkable via ?tab=defaults): default greeting (with {client_name}/{title} variables), default footer and default signer. Saved via PUT /api/emails/defaults/ into EmailTemplateConfig('branded_email').content_overrides; 'Restaurar valores originales' submits registry/settings defaults which clears the overrides. The configured signer is used for standalone sends and previews (proposal emails keep their per-proposal signer).
admin-standalone-email-defaults.knownGaps: Spec does not exercise Branch A ("Restaurar valores originales") nor Branch B (invalid signer 400) (2026-07-16 audit).

admin-standalone-email-attachments.name: Admin Standalone Email Attachments
admin-standalone-email-attachments.description: Admin attaches files to a standalone email from /panel/emails: multiple file input (.pdf/.doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx/.png/.jpg), client-side type and size validation via validateEmailAttachments (~/utils/emailAttachments), per-file remove button, and multipart POST /api/emails/send/ including the attachments. Documented as Branch B of admin-standalone-email-composer but never exercised by its spec.
admin-standalone-email-attachments.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 3): valid upload sent in multipart POST, type-validation rejection and per-file remove over mocked API.

admin-proposal-advanced-filters.name: Admin Proposal Advanced Filters
admin-proposal-advanced-filters.description: Filter proposals using custom saved tabs, status/type/market dropdowns, date range, and text search. Tab bar with add/rename/delete, URL deep-linking via ?tab=<tabId>.

admin-proposal-project-schedule.name: Admin Proposal Project Schedule (Cronograma)
admin-proposal-project-schedule.description: Admin sets per-stage start/end dates (design, development) for an accepted proposal in the Cronograma tab, sees proportional status badges, and marks stages as completed to silence deadline alerts.

admin-client-create-standalone.name: Admin Client Create Standalone
admin-client-create-standalone.description: Create a new client profile from /panel/clients via the modal form, with and without email.

admin-client-delete-orphan.name: Admin Client Delete Orphan
admin-client-delete-orphan.description: Delete an orphan client (zero proposals + zero projects) via the trash icon and confirm modal.

admin-client-delete-protected.name: Admin Client Delete Protected
admin-client-delete-protected.description: Verify that active clients (with proposals or projects) do not expose the delete trash icon.

admin-client-inactive-tab.name: Admin Client Inactive Tab
admin-client-inactive-tab.description: Inactivos tab lists only manually deactivated clients (inactive=true) and the pause/play toggle marks a client inactive or reactivates it.

admin-client-drag-reassign.name: Admin Client Drag Reassign
admin-client-drag-reassign.description: Drag a proposal or diagnostic row from an expanded client and drop it on another client card header or its matching proposals/diagnostics zone to reassign it (PATCH client_id) with an undo notification; details and list refresh silently in place.

admin-proposal-client-autocomplete.name: Admin Proposal Client Autocomplete
admin-proposal-client-autocomplete.description: Client picker autocomplete in proposal create/edit: type to search, select a client to auto-fill snapshot fields, fallback "Crear nuevo" when no match.

admin-proposal-client-no-email.name: Admin Proposal Client No Email
admin-proposal-client-no-email.description: Create a proposal without a client email — backend generates a placeholder email and all automations are paused for that client.

admin-proposal-update-client.name: Admin Proposal Update Client
admin-proposal-update-client.description: Change the linked client on an existing proposal from the proposal edit page (/panel/proposals/:id/edit). Admin selects a different client via the autocomplete and saves; snapshot fields update to reflect the new client.

admin-kanban-tasks.name: Admin Kanban Tasks
admin-kanban-tasks.description: Internal Kanban task board at /panel/tasks (alias /panel/tareas redirects here). Admin can create, edit, move across TO DO/In Progress/Blocked/Done columns, and delete tasks.

admin-task-deadline-notification.name: Admin Task Deadline Notification
admin-task-deadline-notification.description: Huey periodic task sends email notifications to task assignees at 40%, 70%, 100% of deadline and for overdue tasks. Backend-only — no browser interaction.
knownGaps: Backend-only Huey periodic task. Covered by backend unit tests; no E2E spec applies.

admin-document-move-folder.name: Admin Document Move Folder
admin-document-move-folder.description: Admin moves a document to a different folder (or removes it from any folder) via MoveFolderModal from the documents page. PATCHes documents/{id}/update/ with folder_id.

admin-document-send-email.name: Admin Document Send Email
admin-document-send-email.description: Admin sends a branded email with document PDFs attached from the documents list: actions sheet -> 'Enviar por correo' opens SendDocumentEmailModal (recipient, subject, greeting, ordered sections, footer, extra document PDFs picker, Edit/Preview tabs) -> POST /api/emails/send/ with document_ids. Functional successor of the superseded admin-proposal-documents-send flow.
admin-document-send-email.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign): happy path, 429 rate-limited and generic-error branches over mocked API.

admin-document-rename.name: Admin Document Rename
admin-document-rename.description: Admin renames a document from the actions sheet: 'Renombrar' opens RenameDocumentModal with the current title, saving sends PATCH /api/documents/:id/update/ and the list refreshes with the new title.
admin-document-rename.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): happy path + cancel/error branches over mocked API.

admin-document-delete.name: Admin Document Delete
admin-document-delete.description: Admin deletes a document from the actions sheet: 'Eliminar' opens ConfirmModal; confirming sends DELETE /api/documents/:id/delete/ and removes the row/card; cancelling keeps it. Current list spec only asserts the button is visible.
admin-document-delete.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): happy path + cancel/error branches over mocked API.

admin-document-archive.name: Admin Document Archive
admin-document-archive.description: Admin archives documents and folders from /panel/documents, where WHERE (activeFolderId: all | root | none | <id>) and IN WHICH STATE (scope: active | archived | all, default active) are independent axes. The actions sheet offers 'Archivar' (PATCH /api/documents/:id/archive/) and, on an archived document, 'Restaurar' (PATCH /api/documents/:id/unarchive/), whose response reports in `restored_chain` the container folders the backend had to reopen so the document lands somewhere reachable. Each sidebar folder row carries an archive icon (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/archive/, cascading over subfolders and documents and reporting the counts, behind a confirmation showing the inventory) and a delete icon that is DISABLED whenever the folder holds anything, archived content included, matching the backend 409; both name their action in a tooltip. The delete confirmation for a document still offers archiving as a secondary action, visible and enabled BEFORE the DELETE word is typed. The 'Archivados' sidebar entry is a shortcut onto both axes (folder=root, scope=archived): the archive renders as a NAVIGABLE TREE — an archived folder appears as a container, its cascade-archived children are reached by entering it (GET /api/documents/?folder=:id&scope=archived) and the breadcrumb reads 'Archivados › …'. An active folder that still holds archived items shows a badge that opens it in its archived scope. A three-way state filter (Todos / Solo activos / Solo archivados) sits in the toolbar and applies to folders and documents alike; the archived scope keeps its Archivado column, relative age and Recientes / Más antiguos order control (?order=oldest). Search is global — it ignores folder and state (GET /api/documents/?scope=all&search=), visibly moves the filter to Todos and marks each archived hit — and every mutation refreshes the authoritative sidebar counters from GET /api/documents/counts/. Archived items are not drop targets and cannot be dragged.
admin-document-archive.knownGaps: Spec extended 2026-08-12 with the hierarchy/restore wave: archived folder as container, entering it, the reopened container chain reported on restore, the state filter, global search reaching archived items, the mixed-state badge and the counters refreshing with no reload. Still covered only at the backend layer: the cascade-memory rule (items archived individually stay archived when their folder is unarchived), the chain restore leaving the rest of those folders archived, and the guards that reject moving or duplicating active content into an archived folder.

admin-document-folder-manage.name: Admin Document Folder Management
admin-document-folder-manage.description: Admin manages folders in FolderManagerModal: create folder with parent selector (POST /api/document-folders/create/), inline rename (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/update/), delete with confirmation (DELETE /api/document-folders/:id/delete/) and drag-reorder (POST /api/document-folders/reorder/). Existing admin-document-folders spec only covers parent pre-selection on create. The sidebar (FolderSidebar) also exposes a per-row trash icon, enabled on every folder: it opens DeleteFolderModal, which lists the folder inventory. On an empty folder the modal requires typing DELETE (case-sensitive) before confirming and offers archiving alongside; on a folder that still holds content it drops the destructive button entirely and presents archiving as the available action. The folder manager's own delete icon delegates to that same modal, so folder deletion has one contract everywhere.
admin-document-folder-manage.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): create/rename/delete + documents-blocking branch over mocked API. Drag-reorder intentionally not asserted (flaky in CI). Sidebar delete (DELETE-typed confirm, blocked icon, 409 conflict) added 2026-08-04. Rewritten 2026-08-11: the blocked-icon branch is gone (a filled folder now reaches the modal and is offered archiving), and the manager's inline confirmation panel was consolidated into DeleteFolderModal.

admin-document-tags-manage.name: Admin Document Tags Management
admin-document-tags-manage.description: Admin manages tags in TagManagerModal: create tag with name and color (POST /api/document-tags/create/), rename (PATCH /api/document-tags/:id/update/), delete with confirm (DELETE /api/document-tags/:id/delete/). Tag chip filtering is covered by admin-document-folders; tag CRUD is not.
admin-document-tags-manage.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 3): create with color, inline rename, delete behind native confirm + dismissed branch over mocked API.

admin-document-duplicate.name: Admin Document Duplicate
admin-document-duplicate.description: Admin duplicates a document from the actions sheet: 'Duplicar' sends POST /api/documents/:id/duplicate/ and the copy appears in the list.
admin-document-duplicate.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-23 (round 7): duplicate POST with the copy appearing in the refreshed list, plus the error-toast branch.

admin-document-drag-organize.name: Admin Document Drag Organize
admin-document-drag-organize.description: Admin organizes by drag-and-drop: dragging a document card/row onto a sidebar folder moves it (PATCH /api/documents/:id/update/ folder_id), and dragging a folder onto a breadcrumb/sidebar folder re-parents it (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/update/). The modal-based move path is covered by admin-document-move-folder; the drag path is not.
admin-document-drag-organize.knownGaps: Drag interactions untested (fragile in Playwright; needs dispatchEvent-based DnD). Registered 2026-07-16 audit.

admin-document-pdf-download.name: Admin Document PDF Download
admin-document-pdf-download.description: Admin downloads a Document entity as a branded PDF from the document edit page via the 'Descargar PDF' button.

admin-diagnostic-create.name: Admin Diagnostic Create
admin-diagnostic-create.description: Admin creates a new WebAppDiagnostic from /panel/diagnostics/create: searches for a client via autocomplete, selects language, submits → redirected to edit page with 8 JSON sections seeded from the default template.

admin-diagnostic-send-initial.name: Admin Diagnostic Send Initial
admin-diagnostic-send-initial.description: Admin sends the initial-phase diagnostic from the edit page via 'Enviar envío inicial' — POST /api/diagnostics/:id/send-initial/, stamps `initial_sent_at`, status moves DRAFT → SENT. Public view then exposes only sections with visibility ∈ {initial, both}. The follow-up SENT → NEGOTIATING transition is its own flow (`admin-diagnostic-mark-in-analysis`). Since the Jul 2026 UX redesign the send opens a pre-send scorecard modal (GET /api/diagnostics/:id/scorecard/): blockers disable the send button and the backend refuses to transition while blockers remain (400 scorecard_blockers).

admin-diagnostic-mark-in-analysis.name: Admin Diagnostic Mark In Analysis
admin-diagnostic-mark-in-analysis.description: Admin clicks 'Marcar en análisis' on a SENT diagnostic to acknowledge that the client authorized continuing — opens a ConfirmModal and POSTs /api/diagnostics/:id/mark-in-analysis/, transitioning SENT → NEGOTIATING. The button is only available after `initial_sent_at` is set; afterwards the 'Enviar diagnóstico final' action becomes the next user step.

admin-diagnostic-send-final.name: Admin Diagnostic Send Final
admin-diagnostic-send-final.description: Admin sends the final-phase diagnostic from NEGOTIATING via 'Enviar diagnóstico final' (SENT again, final_sent_at stamped). Public view now also exposes sections with visibility ∈ {final}. Gated by the same pre-send scorecard modal as send-initial.

diagnostic-public-view.name: Diagnostic Public View
diagnostic-public-view.description: Client accesses the public diagnostic page via UUID link and navigates the JSON-driven section components (Purpose/Radiography/Categories/DeliveryStructure/ExecutiveSummary/Cost/Timeline/Scope). Initial-phase view hides `final`-only sections. Per-section dwell time is tracked via /api/diagnostics/public/<uuid>/track-section/. Accept/Reject is a separate flow (`diagnostic-public-respond`). Since the Jul 2026 redesign the page opens with a personalized cover ('Comenzar recorrido' starts the tour) and sections swap with a directional slide.

diagnostic-public-respond.name: Diagnostic Public Respond
diagnostic-public-respond.description: On a final-phase SENT public diagnostic, the client clicks 'Aceptar propuesta' or 'Rechazar' in the footer — POST /api/diagnostics/public/<uuid>/respond/ with `decision` ('accept'|'reject'), the page swaps to the acceptance/rejection confirmation footer, and the backend transitions the diagnostic to ACCEPTED or REJECTED. The CTA only appears on the last section (or once the cost section was visited) and asks for confirmation before POSTing, with an explicit sending state.

diagnostic-public-pdf-download.name: Diagnostic Public PDF Download
diagnostic-public-pdf-download.description: Client uses the floating PDF button on the public diagnostic page; browser fetches GET /api/diagnostics/public/:uuid/pdf/. The button shows a spinner while generating and re-enables after the download completes.
knownGaps: Production PDF is generated by ReportLab on the fly; E2E mocks a 200 PDF response and validates the UI path.

diagnostic-public-share.name: Diagnostic Public Share
diagnostic-public-share.description: Client clicks the floating share button on the public diagnostic page; a modal opens with the current URL and a 'Copiar enlace' action. Optionally uses Web Share API if available.

diagnostic-public-dark-mode.name: Diagnostic Public Dark Mode Toggle
diagnostic-public-dark-mode.description: Client toggles dark/light mode via the fixed bottom-left button; the [data-diagnostic-wrapper] element receives data-theme='dark'. Preference persists to localStorage['diagnostic-dark-mode'] and is restored on next page load.

diagnostic-public-onboarding.name: Diagnostic Public Onboarding
diagnostic-public-onboarding.description: First-visit tutorial overlay on the public diagnostic page (DiagnosticOnboarding.vue) that walks the client through the report's structure with step-by-step tooltips, scroll-to-section behavior, and a 'No volver a mostrar' option persisted to localStorage. Mirrors proposal-view-onboarding for the diagnostic module.
knownGaps: DiagnosticOnboarding component (376 lines) shipped 2026-04-26 (commits 9877df24, e827bd38). Component-level unit tests exist (DiagnosticOnboarding.test.js); E2E spec pending.

admin-diagnostic-sections.name: Admin Diagnostic Sections Editor
admin-diagnostic-sections.description: Admin edits the 8 JSON sections from the Secciones tab of the diagnostic edit page. Each section type has a typed form (paragraphs, severity levels, 14-category findings, radiography table, timeline rows, etc.). Changes are debounced and PATCHed to /sections/<id>/update/. The tab also exposes a completeness indicator (% + colored progress bar counting enabled sections with non-empty content_json) and a per-section 'Restaurar contenido por defecto' action (POST /sections/<id>/reset/). Raw-JSON read + bulk apply moved to the JSON tab — see admin-diagnostic-json-export / admin-diagnostic-json-import.

admin-diagnostic-activity.name: Admin Diagnostic Activity Timeline
admin-diagnostic-activity.description: Admin records notes / call / meeting / followup events from the Actividad tab (POST /activity/create/). Timeline shows auto-logged events (created, status change, section updated, email sent, accepted, rejected) alongside manual notes.

admin-diagnostic-analytics.name: Admin Diagnostic Analytics Dashboard
admin-diagnostic-analytics.description: Admin reviews full analytics parity with proposal analytics tab: engagement score (0–100 color-coded), summary KPIs (total views, unique sessions, first view, reading time, coverage, last visit), comparison with global averages, funnel with drop-off %, device breakdown (desktop/mobile/tablet), suggested actions, skipped sections, section heatmap, engagement table, activity timeline, sessions history, and CSV export button. Data sourced from DiagnosticViewEvent + DiagnosticSectionView + DiagnosticChangeLog.

admin-diagnostic-engagement-score.name: Admin Diagnostic Engagement Score
admin-diagnostic-engagement-score.description: Engagement score card renders with correct color-coded level label: Alto engagement (≥70), Engagement moderado (40–69), Bajo engagement (<40). Card hidden when engagement_score is null.

admin-diagnostic-prompt.name: Admin Diagnostic Prompt Editor
admin-diagnostic-prompt.description: Admin copies / edits / downloads the two diagnostic prompts (commercial and technical) from the Prompt tab. State is persisted in localStorage per browser via usePromptState({storageKey, defaultPrompt}).

admin-diagnostic-email.name: Admin Diagnostic Email Composer
admin-diagnostic-email.description: Admin sends a follow-up branded email from the Correos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Composer includes recipient, subject, draggable body sections (per-section Markdown toggle), footer, optional attachments, and a server-rendered preview of the real branded template (POST /api/emails/preview/). NDA branch: checking 'Adjuntar acuerdo de confidencialidad' appends attach_confidentiality:1 to the FormData and the backend generates and attaches the confidentiality PDF. History lists previous sends (sections stored as legacy strings or {text, markdown} objects).

admin-diagnostic-documents.name: Admin Diagnostic Attachment Management
admin-diagnostic-documents.description: Admin uploads, manages, and sends file attachments (PDF, Word, Excel, images) from the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Checkbox selection enables the send-to-client button. The send section also exposes a checkbox for the system-generated Acuerdo de Confidencialidad (when present) which is appended to the email as a watermarked draft. System-generated attachments (is_generated=true) cannot be deleted — DELETE returns HTTP 400; this backend protection is defensive only since the UI filters generated NDAs out of the deletable list.
knownGaps: is_generated delete-blocked branch is backend-only (UI offers no delete button for generated NDAs); covered by backend tests, not E2E.

admin-diagnostic-document-preview.name: Admin Diagnostic Document Preview
admin-diagnostic-document-preview.description: From the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page, admin clicks the eye icon next to an attachment. A modal opens previewing the file inline — PDF (rendered in iframe) or image (via tag), gated by frontend/utils/filePreview.js (canPreviewFile). Non-previewable files keep only the existing download action. Replaces the previous inline template-expand behavior on DiagnosticDocumentsTab.
knownGaps: Eye-icon preview modal replaced inline template-expand in DiagnosticDocumentsTab.vue on 2026-04-26 (commit 9877df24). Component-level unit test exists (DiagnosticDocumentsTab.spec.js); E2E spec pending.

admin-task-alert-management.name: Admin Task Alert Management
admin-task-alert-management.description: Admin defines one or more manual date-based email alerts per task from the TaskFormModal Alertas section. Supports add (date + optional note), list with sent/pending badge, and delete. Alerts fire via Huey daily at 08:10.

admin-diagnostic-edit.name: Admin Diagnostic Edit
admin-diagnostic-edit.description: Admin edits top-level metadata of an existing WebAppDiagnostic from the General tab: title, client (via ClientAutocomplete) + client-snapshot fields (name/email/phone/company) + propagate-to-profile checkbox, language, investment amount + currency, payment terms (initial/final pct), duration label, and size category. Changes are saved via PATCH /api/diagnostics/:id/update/. Radiografía data is edited as a regular section from the Secciones tab. Section content is edited separately under admin-diagnostic-sections; full-JSON round-trip lives under admin-diagnostic-json-export / admin-diagnostic-json-import.

admin-diagnostic-delete.name: Admin Diagnostic Delete
admin-diagnostic-delete.description: Admin deletes an existing WebAppDiagnostic from the diagnostics list or edit page via confirm modal. DELETE /api/diagnostics/:id/delete/.

admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-generat.name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Generate
admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-generat.description: Admin generates the Acuerdo de Confidencialidad (NDA) PDF from the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Section displays 'No generado' with a 'Generar acuerdo' CTA when no NDA exists. CTA opens ConfidentialityParamsModal with 13 fields (cliente: nombre/NIT/representante/email; consultor: nombre/NIT/cédula/email — defaults to Project App SAS / team@projectapp.co; acuerdo: ciudad — default Medellín, día/mes/año, cláusula penal — default 50 SMMLV). The consultor must be identified by NIT or cédula — at least one is required client-side and by ConfidentialityParamsSerializer; the NIT wins when both are present. Submit posts to POST /api/diagnostics/:id/confidentiality/params/, which validates via ConfidentialityParamsSerializer, persists to diagnostic.confidentiality_params, and creates a DiagnosticAttachment with document_type='confidentiality_agreement' and is_generated=true. Section then shows 'Generado el {fecha}' with Descargar / Borrador / Editar parámetros buttons.

admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-edit.name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Edit Params
admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-edit.description: Admin re-opens the ConfidentialityParamsModal via 'Editar parámetros' on a diagnostic that already has a generated NDA. Form pre-fills from diagnostic.confidentiality_params. Admin modifies one or more fields and submits — the existing DiagnosticAttachment file is replaced in place (same row id, file.delete + file.save, single .save() call). Section header still shows 'Generado el {fecha}' with the updated timestamp.

admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-downloa.name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Download
admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-downloa.description: Admin downloads the generated Acuerdo de Confidencialidad from the Documentos tab. 'Descargar' link → GET /api/diagnostics/:id/confidentiality/pdf/ (FileResponse, streams the saved PDF with placeholders filled from confidentiality_params). 'Borrador' link → GET /api/diagnostics/:id/confidentiality/draft-pdf/ (renders fresh with all placeholders forced to XXX-XXX-XXX and applies BORRADOR watermark). When no NDA exists, neither link is present and the section shows 'No generado' with 'Generar acuerdo' CTA.

admin-diagnostic-json-export.name: Admin Diagnostic JSON Export
admin-diagnostic-json-export.description: Admin opens the JSON tab of /panel/diagnostics/:id/edit. A read-only textarea renders the full diagnostic serialized as JSON (metadata + sections). Actualizar refetches /detail/ from the server; Copiar writes the current text to the clipboard; Descargar streams a {slug}.json Blob download. The string is lazy-computed from store.current so it rebuilds only when the tab is rendered.

admin-diagnostic-json-import.name: Admin Diagnostic JSON Import
admin-diagnostic-json-import.description: Admin imports a JSON blob from the JSON tab of /panel/diagnostics/:id/edit, either by pasting into the textarea or uploading a .json file (FileReader → textarea). Parse runs on every input; validation requires a root object with an array `sections`. A preview strip shows client name, section count, and formatted investment. Aplicar JSON runs PATCH /update/ for metadata first, then POST /sections/bulk-update/; success emits an inline toast and resyncs the pricing/radiography forms. Errors surface inline and abort the apply.

admin-diagnostic-defaults-config.name: Admin Diagnostic Defaults Config
admin-diagnostic-defaults-config.description: Admin manages the per-language default config applied to new WebAppDiagnostic rows from /panel/diagnostics/defaults/. The General tab edits language, currency, default investment amount, default duration label, payment percentages (auto-synced to sum 100, default 60/40), and reminder/urgency/expiration days. Save PUTs /api/diagnostics/defaults/?lang= and the response is applied directly (no refetch). Reset opens a ConfirmModal and POSTs /defaults/reset/ to delete the row, falling back to the hardcoded seed. Sections, Plantillas de Email (link), Prompt (placeholder) and JSON tabs render from the same config payload.

admin-proposal-diagnostic-templates.name: Proposal — Documentos Tab
admin-proposal-diagnostic-templates.description: Admin views the 'Documentos' tab on the proposal edit page. Tab is visible for proposals in sent|viewed|negotiating|accepted|rejected status. Shows a unified document list (Contrato de desarrollo, Propuesta comercial PDF, Detalle técnico PDF) plus a 'Documentos adjuntos' section with upload form. Does NOT show 'Enviar documentos al cliente' (that section was removed Apr 22 2026 — sending is done from the Correos tab).

admin-diagnostic-markdown-attachment.name: Diagnostic Email — Markdown to PDF Attachment
admin-diagnostic-markdown-attachment.description: When a diagnostic is in 'negotiating' status, admin sees a 'Crear documento desde markdown' button in the Correos tab. Clicking it opens MarkdownAttachmentModal, which takes a title, a markdown textarea, and three cover-toggle checkboxes. A 'Plantillas base' row provides three copy-to-clipboard buttons (Diagnóstico de Aplicación / Diagnóstico Técnico / Anexo) that fetch GET /api/diagnostic-templates/:slug/ on first click and write the markdown to the clipboard; subsequent clicks use an in-memory cache. The Vista previa button is disabled until both title and markdown are filled; clicking it POSTs to POST /api/diagnostics/:id/email/markdown-attachment/ (returns an inline PDF). The PDF is rendered in an iframe for review. Clicking Adjuntar converts the blob to a File and emits @attach — appending it to the email attachments list with a success toast.

proposal-value-added-modules.name: Proposal Value Added Modules
proposal-value-added-modules.description: Public proposal section (section_type value_added_modules) renders a card grid of included-free modules resolved from the proposal's functional_requirements groups. Each card shows title, icon, justification text, and a 'Gratis' badge. An optional footer_note is displayed below the grid. Falls back to 'Incluido sin costo adicional' when no title is provided in content_json. Clicking a card opens the shared requirements modal, including the nested linked-requirements link when technical requirements reference the module item ids. Per-module conditions gate benefits: when the effective total is below the module minimum a 'Disponible en proyectos desde $X' badge is shown (condicionado; never hidden), plus optional duration and discretionary-note badges. A 'Términos y condiciones' button opens a per-module ModuleTermsModal without triggering the card detail modal.
knownGaps: Terms modal now renders **bold** via renderInlineBold (2026-07); bold output not asserted (mock terms carry no ** markers).
Canonical card order admin>manual>kpi_dashboard>analytics>ai_automation (2026-07) not asserted.

admin-diagnostic-list.name: Admin Diagnostic List
admin-diagnostic-list.description: Admin views the list of all WebAppDiagnostics, searches by client name or title, and navigates to create or edit flows.

admin-diagnostic-filters.name: Admin Diagnostic Filters
admin-diagnostic-filters.description: Filter diagnostics using saved tabs with localStorage persistence and URL sync (?tab=<tabId>). Filter dimensions: statuses (multi-select), investmentMin/Max, createdAfter/Before. Tab bar supports add/rename/delete (max 12 tabs).
admin-diagnostic-filters.knownGaps: Own-tag tests added 2026-07-23 (round 6): status dimension filtering, Limpiar todo reset and diagnosticTab URL sync, inside admin-diagnostic-advanced-filters.spec.js.

admin-diagnostic-advanced-filters.name: Admin Diagnostic Advanced Filters
admin-diagnostic-advanced-filters.description: Admin filters diagnostics from /panel/diagnostics via DiagnosticFilterPanel + ProposalFilterTabs. Default view shows all diagnostics. 'Filtros' toggle opens/closes the filter panel (Estados dimension visible). '+' button creates a named saved-filter tab (persisted to localStorage). Search input filters the card list by title client-side.

admin-client-edit.name: Admin Client Edit
admin-client-edit.description: Admin edits an existing client profile from /panel/clients by clicking the edit (pencil) icon on a client row. The edit modal opens pre-filled with the client's name, email, phone, and company. Admin modifies fields and submits — PUT /api/proposals/client-profiles/:id/update/ — modal closes on success. A 400 response surfaces validation errors and keeps the modal open.

admin-defaults-unified.name: Admin Unified Defaults Shell
admin-defaults-unified.description: Admin navigates to /panel/defaults — a unified shell page with a Propuesta/Diagnóstico mode switch. Default mode is proposal. Clicking Diagnóstico updates the URL to ?mode=diagnostic and renders DiagnosticDefaultsPanel. Direct navigation to ?mode=diagnostic lands in diagnostic mode. The back link label changes by mode (Volver a Propuestas / Volver a Diagnósticos). Old routes /panel/proposals/defaults and /panel/diagnostics/defaults redirect here preserving the ?tab= param.

admin-layout-title-mapping.name: Admin Layout Browser Tab Title
admin-layout-title-mapping.description: Browser tab title in admin.vue updates reactively to show 'Project App (ViewName)' based on the current route. Covers: exact match (dashboard), static prefix match, more-specific route priority, and dynamic regex routes (/panel/proposals/:id/edit → 'Edit. propuesta').

platform-layout-title-mapping.name: Platform Layout Browser Tab Title
platform-layout-title-mapping.description: Browser tab title in platform.vue updates reactively to show 'Project App (ViewName)'. Covers: static route (dashboard, projects), dynamic project base route (/platform/projects/:id → 'Proyecto'), and nested dynamic route ordering (/platform/projects/:id/board → 'Tablero' beats project base regex).

admin-proposal-platform-handoff.name: Admin Proposal → Platform Handoff
admin-proposal-platform-handoff.description: After a proposal is accepted, admin clicks 'Lanzar a plataforma' from the actions modal — POST /api/proposals/:id/launch-to-platform/ — which creates a PlatformProject linked to the proposal and sends the client a platform invitation email with an OTP. Admin sees a 'Ver en plataforma' action in the proposal actions panel. Client then starts the platform onboarding flow (platform-login → platform-verify-onboarding → platform-complete-profile).

diagnostic-public-phase-visibility.name: Diagnostic Public Phase Visibility
diagnostic-public-phase-visibility.description: The public diagnostic page renders different sections depending on the diagnostic phase. After admin sends initial phase (initial_sent_at set, status=SENT), only sections with visibility ∈ {initial, both} appear. After admin sends final phase (final_sent_at set), sections with visibility='final' (e.g. executive_summary, cost, timeline) are also returned by the API and appear in the sidebar. E2E should mock two API responses (initial-phase vs final-phase) and assert which section types render in each state.

admin-proposal-section-disable.name: Admin Proposal Section Disable/Enable Toggle
admin-proposal-section-disable.description: Admin toggles section visibility (is_enabled) from the Secciones tab of the proposal edit page. Each section row has an enable/disable toggle; disabled sections are greyed out in the admin list and excluded from the public proposal view. PATCH /api/proposals/sections/:id/update/ with { is_enabled: false }. Complements admin-proposal-section-reorder — both operations can be combined in sequence.
knownGaps: Admin side covered; no assertion that a disabled section disappears from the public view (2026-07 audit).

admin-proposal-section-sync.name: Admin Proposal Section Sync (Preview & Apply)
admin-proposal-section-sync.description: Admin uses the SyncPreviewModal on the proposal edit page to preview a server-computed diff between the current section's content_json and the canonical default, then applies the sync to overwrite. Backend endpoints: GET /api/proposals/sections/:id/sync-preview/ and POST /api/proposals/sections/:id/apply-sync/. UI lives at frontend/components/BusinessProposal/admin/SyncPreviewModal.vue (mounted in pages/panel/proposals/[id]/edit.vue).

proposal-magic-link-request.name: Proposal Magic Link Request (Expired)
proposal-magic-link-request.description: Guest who lands on an expired proposal submits their email to receive a fresh magic-link via the form in ProposalExpired.vue. Calls POST /api/proposals/request-link/ with { email } and shows a neutral confirmation message ('Si tenemos propuestas asociadas a ese email, recibirás un enlace en breve.') regardless of backend outcome to avoid leaking which emails are clients. Out of scope of proposal-expired-graceful (which covers the expired-state UI).

proposal-slug-access.name: Proposal Slug Access
proposal-slug-access.description: Client accesses a proposal via its human-friendly slug URL (/proposal/<slug>/). The store detects non-UUID identifiers and routes the request to the by-slug API endpoint. UUID-based access must still work for backward compatibility. Unknown slugs must render the 404/not-found state.

admin-proposal-slug-edit.name: Admin Proposal Slug Edit
admin-proposal-slug-edit.description: Admin sets or regenerates the human-friendly slug (URL personalizada) for a proposal from the General tab. Includes format validation (lowercase/numbers/hyphens), uniqueness error on 400, and one-click regeneration from client name. PATCH /api/proposals/:id/update/ with { slug }.

admin-proposal-defaults-slug-pattern.name: Admin Proposal Defaults — Slug Pattern
admin-proposal-defaults-slug-pattern.description: Admin configures the default slug pattern used when new proposals are created (e.g. {client_name}, {client_name}-{year}). Live preview shows the slugified result. Saved to ProposalDefaultConfig.default_slug_pattern via PUT /api/proposals/defaults/.

platform-access-view.name: Platform Access View
platform-access-view.description: Admin-only quick-access hub at /platform/access: grid of project cards with clickable URLs (production, staging, Django admin, repository) and copy/reveal credential controls.

admin-accounting-dashboard.name: Admin Accounting Dashboard
admin-accounting-dashboard.description: Superuser opens /panel/accounting and sees the financial overview fed by GET /api/accounting/dashboard/?year=: expected vs liquid income, expenses, utilities and monthly breakdown computed from the company ledger only (personal-ledger records excluded), pocket balance, per-partner cards (Gustavo/Carlos combine company participation + personal ledger; ProjectApp (Empresa) shows the full company ledger totals), operative cost cards and latest card snapshots. The hero Utilidad líquida card embeds a full-width 'Utilidad por mes' ApexCharts line with axes and money tooltips (replaced the corner sparkline). The subnav orders Bolsillo second, after Resumen. Includes the superuser gate: staff non-superusers are redirected to /panel and the Accounting sidebar section is hidden. Includes the Evolución section: two ApexCharts (expected vs liquid vs expenses per month, and card-debt evolution from snapshots) driven by the year selector plus a client-side month-range filter, a link to the cards history and the year persisted as a query param.

admin-accounting-expected-detail.name: Admin Accounting Expected Income Detail
admin-accounting-expected-detail.description: Superuser clicks the 'Pendiente por cobrar · {mes}' stat card on /panel/accounting and a read-only modal opens with the company expected incomes of the real current month (GET /api/accounting/incomes/?kind=expected&ledger=company&date_from&date_to derived from expected_current_month.period, not the year selector). The table lists concepto, período, total, abonado (paid_amount), pendiente (pending_amount, per-row clamped) and payment status pill, with a footer whose Pendiente sum equals the card total. Cerrar closes the modal; no actions on rows.

admin-accounting-stats-modals.name: Admin Accounting Stats Modals
admin-accounting-stats-modals.description: Superuser opens descriptive-statistics modals from the accounting Resumen: the Ingresos líquidos, Gastos {year} and Deuda tarjetas stat cards are clickable buttons and the hero Utilidad card exposes an Estadísticas button. Each modal is a StatsModal (BaseModal 5xl + BaseTabs) with tabbed ApexCharts views: Ingresos (evolución esperado vs líquido, % de cobro radial+mensual, top conceptos), Gastos (evolución con promedio, distribución Negocio/Personal, recurrente vs variable, top conceptos), Utilidad (evolución, márgenes, socios) and Tarjetas (evolución de deuda, uso del cupo por tarjeta, histórico de cortes). Income/expense tabs feed from GET /api/accounting/stats/?year= (lazy, cached per year in the accounting store, reset on year change); utility/cards tabs compute client-side from the dashboard summary and card snapshots.

admin-accounting-income-crud.name: Admin Accounting Income CRUD
admin-accounting-income-crud.description: Superuser manages income records at /panel/accounting/incomes, a list that lands on the builtin "Solo esperados" tab (kind=expected + paymentStatus=pending) rather than on "Todas": create via modal with automatic 50/50 partner split (editable), a period field that defaults to today's exact date with a month-only toggle (shared PeriodDateField; edits always open in full-date mode showing the stored day — 01 is the month-only storage sentinel — with the toggle still downgrading to month), ledger selector (Contabilidad: Empresa / Personal Gustavo / Personal Carlos — personal hides the split and pocket destination and uses a single Valor field) which is a filter only, with no column of its own since Aug 2026, edit with prefill (PATCH /api/accounting/incomes/:id/update/), delete with ConfirmModal (DELETE .../delete/), HTML5 required validation and backend error toasts via usePanelNotify. Each list also exposes column sorting (asc/desc/off) on key columns. Expected rows carry a fulfilment state in their own "Cobro" column, computed from their linked liquid records (Pagado green tint / Parcial amber tint with the outstanding amount inline / Pendiente untinted) and two extra row actions: 'Liquidar', which opens a modal prefilled with the pending amount (destination defaults to Bolsillo ProjectApp; the payment period asks for the exact date by default, prefilled with today, with the 'Registrar el día exacto de pago' toggle downgrading to month-only) and POSTs to /api/accounting/incomes/:id/settle/, which registers the liquid record linked via expected_income (the expected row survives, so partial payments accumulate). Since Aug 2026 the amount received may be 0 when the shortfall is fully allocated: the settlement then creates no liquid record and sends no payment email — it only books the allocations (a deduction credits the parent as payment; a follow-up shrinks it), rescuing old partial collections whose fee-sized residual would otherwise stay 'Parcial' forever (the same path the resolve_income_residual management command uses). A fixed hint under the pending block tells the user that typing a lower received amount unlocks the resolution paths; when the amount received is below the pending balance the modal reveals the 'Saldo por resolver' section with the deductions group auto-expanded once per open (an untouched auto-added row — in either group — neither blocks the submit nor reaches the payload, so leaving the rest pending stays one click) with a live status badge next to the section total (info 'Sin asignar' while a remainder stays pending, success once the balance is fully resolved, danger with the excess when the allocation overflows) and two collapsible, repeatable groups: 'No es un cobro pendiente, es un gasto' (concept starts unselected behind a 'Seleccionar concepto' placeholder and must be picked explicitly — options Comisión plataforma de pago / Comisión bancaria / Retención en la fuente / Otro, the last one requiring free text; selector and amount share the row via a responsive grid that keeps the longest label readable and stacks below sm) which books the shortfall as an ExpenseRecord flagged with deduction_type and no pocket movement, and 'Sí lo voy a cobrar: crear ingreso esperado' which reschedules it as one or more new expected incomes inheriting the parent's ledger, destination and partner ratio. Both can be combined; follow-ups are subtracted from the expected record while deductions stay inside it as payment credit, so it closes with no orphan balance, and anything left unallocated simply stays pending as before. Each line amount input suggests the still-unassigned remainder as its placeholder and adopts it (selected, ready to overtype) on click or tab focus while empty; a zero remainder is suggested but never auto-filled.
