Every non-pristine line validates inline (red border + message under the row): missing concept, empty/zero amount, missing free text on Otro, missing concept/month on follow-ups, and the line whose amount pushed the sum over the balance is flagged with the excess without erasing what was typed. Over-allocating or any invalid line disables the submit and a persistent aria-live note next to the button explains why; an unallocated remainder never blocks. Deductions keep the expected income gross and count as payment credit via their source_income link; they reduce expected utility as real expenses (liquid utility already arrives net of them) and surface in the Gastos tab with a 'Descuento de ingreso' pill, a per-type filter and their own 'Naturaleza' filter, and 'Marcar como perdido', offered only on rows with no payments yet, which PATCHes kind=lost. Besides the landing tab the view ships two more builtin quick tabs: 'Hosting esperados' (the same cut plus the search term 'hosting', which seeds the search box) and 'Perdidos'; builtin tabs never drift, and '?accounting_incomeTab=all' opens the full list. Written-off income is a third kind, visible under 'Todos' and isolable via the builtin 'Perdidos' quick tab (or the 'Pérdidas' segment in the filter panel), with its own total chip and a 'Perdido (año)' KPI. Since Aug 2026 the row icons are a single three-dots button opening IncomeActionsModal (shared by the grouped and classic views, which had drifted apart), the Gustavo/Carlos columns moved into the income detail modal, and a Proyecto column joins Cliente. Since Aug 2026 every row also offers 'Duplicar' — available whatever the state, since the frequent case is reopening the next period of an already collected hosting — and the same action sits in the income detail modal. It does not write: it GETs /api/accounting/incomes/:id/duplicate-draft/ and opens the income form seeded with the original's concept, amounts, split, ledger, client, project, origin and notes, always as 'Esperado' and never carrying the original's settlement links, cuenta de cobro, deductions, history or silenced reminders. The proposed date is the original's plus one hosting cycle when the hosting behind it can be resolved unambiguously (labelled as such under the field); otherwise it opens empty and the field's required blocks the save until a date is chosen. Because most of the book carries no origin and no client, that lookup resolves for almost no income, so the form also offers cadence shortcuts ('+1 mes', '+3 meses', '+6 meses', '+1 año') built server-side from the original's date: picking one fills the field (in month granularity when the exact-day toggle is off) and marks itself pressed, and it overrides the hosting proposal when the two disagree. While the draft is being fetched the row's three-dots button spins and refuses a second click, since the action menu closes on click. Confirming POSTs through the ordinary create endpoint, so the new row gets a row flash and an 'Ingreso duplicado' toast that reads apart from a manual alta; a failing draft only raises 'No se pudo preparar el duplicado'.

admin-accounting-income-client.name: Admin Accounting Income Client Link
admin-accounting-income-client.description: Superuser links each income to the client it came from at /panel/accounting/incomes. The income form carries a searchable client picker (with inline client creation) and an Origen control for the business line (desarrollo/hosting/diagnostico/otro); the client is optional, so a refund or a financial yield can stay unassigned. The table shows a Cliente column, the filter panel gains Cliente (options derived from the loaded rows plus a "Sin cliente" sentinel) and Origen filters, and a "Sin cliente" builtin tab isolates the rows still to be completed. Those rows are completed in bulk from the shared ClientBulkAssignBar, the same component /panel/accounting/hostings uses: checkboxes select rows (or every filtered row) and TWO separate actions act on them. "Asignar cliente" stays disabled while no client is picked, with the reason inline — an empty picker no longer means unlink — and "Desvincular cliente" only appears when a selected row actually has a client. Either action opens a confirmation naming the scope before anything is written: how many rows gain a client, how many change one and from which client (a mixed selection is broken down instead of presented as a single operation), plus the full scrollable list of affected records. Only the rows that actually change travel in POST /api/accounting/incomes/bulk-assign-client/ (one audit entry per income), and the toast afterwards reports how many the server really wrote. A "Totales por cliente" modal breaks the FILTERED incomes down into billed / collected / pending / weight per client with a totals row, so the period comes from the active filters. Settling an income carries its client and origin into the liquid child, and a client holding incomes can no longer be deleted. The list can also render GROUPED BY CLIENT: the backend setting income_default_view_mode (edited in Configuración) decides the landing mode on every visit, the in-page Agrupado/Clásico segmented toggle lasts only the session (nothing persists on the device), and the grouped table shows per-client headers (count, billed, pending, weight share) over the whole filtered set with a trailing 'Sin cliente' bucket flagged 'por completar' and billed/collected/pending footer totals. Since Ago 2026 the grouped view also carries the selection: a checkbox per row, one per client group that ticks or clears the whole group and reads indeterminate while only part of it is selected, and a header 'seleccionar todos' spanning every group — with no pagination here, that is exactly the filtered set. A collapsed group states how many of its rows are selected, because they keep counting towards the bulk action; the selection lives on the page, so it survives switching between Agrupado and Clásico; and the same ClientBulkAssignBar drives the same two actions, now sticky at the bottom (incomes and hostings alike) and flagging '· N fuera del filtro actual' when part of the selection no longer passes the active filters — the action still includes those rows and the confirmation lists them. Column sort and pagination stay classic-only. A 'Sin cliente' KPI card (without_client_count, whole filtered set) surfaces the completion debt, the search box also matches the linked client's name/company (server-side q included), each unassigned row in the classic table wears a 'sin vincular' pill, reassigning an expected's client cascades to its settled liquids, and the cuenta de cobro adopts the client on an orphan income or rejects a mismatched one.

admin-accounting-filters.name: Admin Accounting Filters
admin-accounting-filters.description: Superuser filters the incomes list client-side: period date range, total amount min/max, kind segmented (Esperado/Líquido), collection segmented ("Cobro": Todos/Sin pagos/Parcial/Pagado, mirroring the row payment badge; its "Sin pagos" value also backs the builtin "Solo esperados" landing tab, next to the seeded "Todos los esperados"), partner segmented (Gustavo/Carlos/ProjectApp), ledger segmented (Todas/Empresa/Personal Gustavo/Personal Carlos), free-text search with debounce, active-filter count badge and reset. Powered by useAccountingFilters + AccountingFilterPanel. The revamped panel adds live-updating range dropdowns (debounced input), removable applied-filter chips, a filtered results counter and <mark> highlighting of search occurrences in the table. Saved tabs carry a base_filters restore point (all five panel views): filter edits under a tab still auto-save, but a drifted tab shows a '•' dot and its context menu offers 'Restaurar filtros' (back to the seeded/created definition) and 'Fijar como base' (re-baseline), so a seeded tab can always recover its meaning (the builtin tabs need none: they never drift).

admin-accounting-expenses-crud.name: Admin Accounting Expenses CRUD
admin-accounting-expenses-crud.description: Superuser manages expense records at /panel/accounting/expenses with category (Negocio/Personal) and ledger (Contabilidad) badges, partner split (hidden for personal-ledger expenses, which use a single Valor field) and the same modal CRUD + filters pattern as incomes. Money inputs live-format es-CO thousands separators (BaseCurrencyInput). Since Jul 2026 the modal has a 'Registrar egreso en bolsillo' toggle (on by default): on creates/keeps a linked pocket OUT movement (bidirectional sync, edits/deletes mirror/cascade), off covers paper adjustments and expenses that never touched the pocket; a personal-ledger expense with the toggle on is stored as a company draw (ledger company, full split to the owner, warning hint in the modal) so pocket money always counts against company utility; on edit the toggle can link/unlink deliberately. Since Aug 2026 the period field captures the exact date by default ('Fecha', prefilled with today, shared PeriodDateField) with a toggle down to month-only ('Mes'); edits always open in full-date mode showing the stored day (01 for month-only records; the toggle still downgrades to month) and the backend already renders full dates as '17 Julio 2026'. Since Aug 2026 deductions are first-class in the tab: a 'Tipo de deducción' multi filter (shared catalog with the liquidation modal), Operativo/Deducciones chips over the filtered rows, a 'Deducciones (año)' KPI card with the per-type breakdown, the pill tooltip naming the origin income (source_income link), and the edit modal hiding the pocket toggle behind a hint for deduction rows — they are created from Liquidar only and reduce utility under the gross-income convention.

admin-accounting-hostings.name: Admin Accounting Hostings
admin-accounting-hostings.description: Superuser manages the client hosting registry at /panel/accounting/hostings: list with an inline estado select (Activo/Inactivo, PATCHes on change with snap-back), validity, 4 KPI cards (active count, monthly income, expiring in 30 days, historic total paid from list meta) and modal CRUD with per-modality payment defaults plus client billing contact fields (email, contact name, identification). Ciclos/total pagado are read-only in the form (computed from the cycle history). Since Aug 2026 Cliente renders the linked relation (client_display_name) instead of the free-text `Persona - Marca` label, and Proyecto is a column of its own.

admin-accounting-hosting-client.name: Admin Accounting Hosting Client Link
admin-accounting-hosting-client.description: Every hosting belongs to a client, so the hosting form carries a searchable client picker with inline creation and requires it on NEW records. Records saved before the relation kept the client as free text following the house convention "Persona - Marca": opening one searches that text and offers the matching registered client for confirmation (accent- and case-blind, both halves tried against name and company), while a still-unlinked record is flagged as pending and stays saveable — completing it is a separate step. The table shows the client with a "sin vincular" pill, the filter panel gains a Cliente filter with a "Sin cliente" sentinel, a builtin tab isolates the pending group, and a header card counts it. Rows are completed in bulk from the shared ClientBulkAssignBar, the same component /panel/accounting/incomes uses: TWO separate actions act on the selection. "Asignar cliente" stays disabled while no client is picked, with the reason inline — an empty picker no longer means unlink — and "Desvincular cliente" only appears when a selected row actually has a client. Either action opens a confirmation naming the scope before anything is written: how many rows gain a client, how many change one and from which client (a mixed selection is broken down instead of presented as a single operation), plus the full scrollable list of affected records. Only the rows that actually change travel in POST /api/accounting/hostings/bulk-assign-client/ (one audit entry per hosting), and the toast afterwards reports how many the server really wrote. Selecting a client seeds the billing snapshot without overwriting what the operator typed. The cuenta de cobro then inherits the client: the send action gates on the resolved recipient (hosting override, else the client address) instead of a hosting-only email, issues on that client's PA-{CODE}-{NNN} series and links the document to the client user. A client holding hostings can no longer be deleted, and the client card lists their hostings with the monthly total alongside their incomes.

admin-accounting-pocket.name: Admin Accounting Pocket Ledger
admin-accounting-pocket.description: Superuser manages the ProjectApp pocket ledger at /panel/accounting/pocket: balance card from list meta, running-balance column (default view newest-first). The pocket is the money entry point: creating a movement also creates its linked income (IN) or expense (OUT). A new movement opens on Egreso, the common case, with every direction-dependent field already in its egreso variant; editing keeps the direction the record has. For IN the Contabilidad segmented is company-only; for OUT the selector is relabeled 'Atribuir a' (Empresa/Gustavo/Carlos) because pocket money is company money: every OUT mirrors a company-ledger expense that counts against liquid utility — Empresa splits 50/50, a partner option registers a draw fully assigned to that partner (category personal). Linked movements open the edit modal with the direction locked and the attribution prefilled (derived from the split); edits mirror into the linked record and deletes cascade both ways (confirm warns about the cascade). Unlinked historical movements keep plain CRUD.

admin-accounting-recurring.name: Admin Accounting Recurring Payments
admin-accounting-recurring.description: Superuser manages recurring operational costs at /panel/accounting/recurring: monthly COP total card, monthly USD cost card (computed with the configurable exchange rate from settings), a monthly breakdown card switchable by category/frequency/payment method, and modal CRUD where the COP-equivalent field only applies to USD payments. The default grouped view lists payments by category with per-group monthly COP subtotals, a grand total, drag-and-drop manual ordering (disabled while a filter is active) and an editable category catalog; a classic view keeps the sortable, paginated table. The frequency catalog runs from monthly through bimestral, trimestral, cuatrimestral, semestral, anual and the every-2/3-years options, plus a "Personalizada" cycle of N months whose form field only appears once it is picked. Every amount is normalized to its monthly equivalent, so a quarterly or custom charge is comparable with a monthly one. A "Gráfico" action beside the view toggle opens a wide charts modal over the same filtered rows — donut by category, ranked bars by item, composition by currency/method/cost type and a calendar of charges by day of month — with the table's active filters shown as chips, an inactive-payments toggle and PNG export. Picking a category (from the legend, a donut slice or the select) drills the whole modal into it: the donut stops splitting by category and splits by the payments inside that one, the legend swaps to those payments — each with its weight inside the category and, muted, its weight over the general total — the center total becomes the category's, and a header names the category and returns to the general view in one click. A category holding a single payment says so by name, so its 100% slice reads as the real breakdown.

admin-accounting-history.name: Admin Accounting History
admin-accounting-history.description: Superuser audits the accounting module at /panel/accounting/history through two tabs. 'Cambios': server-paginated change log (GET /api/accounting/change-logs/, 20 per page) with entity/action/actor/date filters and expandable field-level old→new diffs per entry. 'Envíos': server-paginated send log (GET /api/accounting/email-log/, 20 per page) showing which recipients each automated email of the module actually reached — one row per address — with notice-type/status/recipient/date filters and, on a failed row, the delivery error expanded on click. This is how 'why didn't I get that notice' is diagnosed.

admin-accounting-settings.name: Admin Accounting Settings
admin-accounting-settings.description: Superuser configures accounting email notifications at /panel/accounting/settings. The recipient list is its own catalog (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/accounting/notification-recipients/, audited): every row shows the address, whether it is Activo or Pausado and its fecha de alta; adding validates the format and rejects duplicates case-insensitively with the error inline; a per-row switch pauses a recipient without deleting it; removing asks for confirmation naming the automations that stop arriving. Each row saves on its own, not through the page's save button. Every automated email of the module — change notices, card-debt and statement reminders, the payment calendar, cuentas de cobro and hosting payment outcomes — goes to the active recipients and to nobody else. The master switch (notifications_enabled, PATCH /api/accounting/settings/update/) pauses all of it at once; with it off, or with zero active recipients, the panel warns explicitly that nobody is being notified. Also hosts the weekly card-debt reminder toggle (Fridays 9:00 Bogotá, re-alert every 2 days until the snapshot is registered), the statement reminder toggle (every 8 days at 9:05 Bogotá while the previous month's statement of an active catalog card is missing, draft or lacks its PDF), the 'Catálogo de tarjetas' section (see admin-accounting-card-catalog), the hosting expiry notices toggle (15/7 days before valid_to, then every 5 days until the cuenta de cobro is sent), the USD exchange rate used by the recurring USD KPI, and the 'Vista de ingresos' segmented control (income_default_view_mode: whether /panel/accounting/incomes lands grouped by client or as the classic table on every visit; the in-page toggle is session-only).

admin-accounting-ads.name: Admin Accounting Ads Log
admin-accounting-ads.description: Superuser tracks advertising spend at /panel/accounting/ads: chronological list with a computed running accumulated column (calculated over the full history), origin-card and platform filters, saved filter tabs (accounting_ads view with seeded defaults) and modal CRUD.

admin-accounting-hosting-billing.name: Admin Accounting Hosting — Enviar Cuenta de Cobro
admin-accounting-hosting-billing.description: Superuser sends a client the cuenta de cobro from a hosting row at /panel/accounting/hostings: the paper-plane action (disabled without client email) opens a ConfirmModal previewing amount/recipient, POSTs /api/accounting/hostings/:id/send-collection-account/ which issues the Document (public number, one line item for the next modality period, issuer default payment methods), emails the client the branded message with the PDF attached and stamps billing_requested_at (pauses the expiry notices; a 'Cobro enviado' badge appears). Partial failure (email down) keeps the document issued and warns to re-send from Cobros.

admin-accounting-collections.name: Admin Accounting Cuentas de Cobro Center
admin-accounting-collections.description: Superuser manages all cuentas de cobro at /panel/accounting/collections (tab renamed from Cobros): status counters (emitidas/pagadas/vencidas/anuladas with totals), segmented status filter, table with numero/origen (hosting/proyecto/ingreso/otro)/cliente/total/emision/vence/estado (Vencida tint via is_overdue) and row actions: view linked income, download PDF, resend to client, mark paid (expected-linked accounts route through the Liquidar modal instead of a plain confirm), cancel (cancelling a hosting-linked account resumes its expiry notices; cancelling frees the linked income for a new cuenta). Since Aug 2026 Cliente and Proyecto are separate sortable, filterable columns and the row opens admin-accounting-collection-detail.

admin-accounting-collection-create.name: Admin Accounting Cuenta de Cobro Create + Preview
admin-accounting-collection-create.description: Superuser creates a cuenta de cobro from the Cuentas de cobro tab button or from an income row action (kind expected/liquid, never lost; incomes with an active cuenta are blocked and expose a Ver cuenta de cobro navigation instead). The modal unifies with the clients module (ClientAutocomplete prefills name/NIT/cedula/email into an editable snapshot; inline client creation without leaving the flow), requires selecting an income via searchable combobox — or creating the expected income inline via the stacked income form. The combobox asks for the whole eligible ledger once (no client param) and narrows it on the page through two chip groups above the search box, each option carrying its own count: Alcance (Del cliente, the default once a client is picked and literally only their rows / Todos, the way to reach the still-unassigned incomes and the ones filed under someone else) and Estado (Todos / Esperados / Líquidos). Because the filtering is client-side the counts are exact and switching a chip costs no request, so the dropdown stays open and the cursor stays in the search box; the chips narrow the set the concept search then runs over, and both reset to their defaults whenever the client changes. Under Todos the rows split into De {cliente} / De otros clientes (each naming its owner) / Sin cliente, with the unassigned ones selectable on purpose — issuing adopts the client onto them, announced under the field before the send. A combination with no rows names itself («Acme Soluciones no tiene ingresos esperados.») and offers «Ver todos (N)» instead of rendering a blank panel, and the list now also closes on click-outside or Esc. Each group still declares how many rows it holds back; pairing an income with a different client raises an inline warning that blocks the preview until it is resolved, suggests an editable per-client consecutivo PA-{CODE}-{NNN} (sent only when edited), and ends in a mandatory step-2 preview rendering the REAL email subject/body and attached PDF (same backend pipeline as the send, rolled back server-side) side by side in a full-height two-column review with a draggable divider, independent scroll per column and a fixed header/footer, collapsing into Correo/PDF tabs below 1024px (opening on the PDF under 640px), before Confirmar y enviar issues, emails and links the document to the income. Marking an expected-linked cuenta as paid opens the Liquidar modal prefilled (never a silent settlement); a fully-settled income auto-marks its cuenta paid backend-side.

admin-accounting-collection-detail.name: Collection Account Detail
admin-accounting-collection-detail.description: Superuser inspects one cuenta de cobro without leaving the tab: the row shows Cliente and Proyecto as separate columns, and the detail modal carries the linked income with its settlement history plus the emitted document in a Documento tab. Going to the income is the optional exit and must land on a tab that does not filter the focused row out.

admin-accounting-hosting-cycles.name: Admin Accounting Hosting Cycle Payments
admin-accounting-hosting-cycles.description: Superuser registers hosting cycle payments from the clock action at /panel/accounting/hostings: the modal shows the cycle history (modality + amount snapshotted per paid period, consolidated 'histórico' backfill rows flagged) and a register form prefilled from the contract (amount = payment_per_cycle, modality, paid_at = today) with an 'Extender vigencia' toggle (on by default: valid_to advances one modality period, re-arming the expiry notices). total_paid/cycles_count recompute from the history; deleting a cycle recalculates but never rolls back valid_to.

admin-accounting-hosting-inline-edit.name: Admin Accounting Hosting Inline Edit
admin-accounting-hosting-inline-edit.description: Superuser edits hosting cells without opening the modal at /panel/accounting/hostings: double-click on cliente, dominio or valor/mes swaps the cell for an input (money cells use BaseCurrencyInput), Enter/blur PATCHes only when the value changed, Esc cancels; a failed PATCH leaves the row untouched. The estado column is an inline select that PATCHes is_active with snap-back and spinner.

admin-accounting-settings-reset-tabs.name: Admin Accounting Settings — Reset Saved Filter Tabs
admin-accounting-settings-reset-tabs.description: Superuser restores the seeded default filter tabs per accounting view from /panel/accounting/settings: the 'Pestañas de filtros guardados' card lists the 6 views (Ingresos/Gastos/Hostings/Bolsillo/Recurrentes/Ads) each with a Restablecer button that, after a ConfirmModal warning about custom tabs, POSTs accounts/saved-filter-tabs/reset/ (delete + re-seed atomically) and toasts the result.

admin-mcps.name: Admin MCPs Connectors
admin-mcps.description: Superuser manages MCP connectors at /panel/mcps: each connector is a collapsible accordion row (name, connection-status badge, active toggle) that expands inline to reveal connection status, recent activity and the tool catalog in nested sub-accordions; generates/rotates the connector token (one-time URL modal with copy, GET /api/mcp-connectors/ + POST /api/mcp-connectors/<slug>/generate-token/), and toggles is_active. Includes the superuser gate: staff non-superusers are redirected to /panel.

admin-accounting-cards.name: Admin Accounting Card Snapshots
admin-accounting-cards.description: Superuser manages weekly credit-card balance snapshots at /panel/accounting/cards: list with latest-debt-per-card chip, filters (date range, debt range, card multi-select), create via modal (date defaults to today, card picked from a dropdown fed by the CreditCard catalog; the Deuda input is gone — debt is server-computed as cupo − disponible and previewed in the form, which blocks disponible > cupo), edit prefill (legacy names outside the catalog injected as an extra option) and delete with ConfirmModal. Registering a snapshot dated on/after the cycle Friday silences the weekly card-debt email reminder. The card filter defaults to the active catalog cards as removable chips (clearing them surfaces historical names); its options are the union of catalog and snapshot names, and a saved tab in the URL wins over the preselection.

admin-accounting-export.name: Admin Accounting Export
admin-accounting-export.description: Superuser exports accounting data: every list view has an Exportar dropdown (CSV / Excel .xlsx) that calls GET /api/accounting/export/ with the active filters mapped to server query params, and the dashboard has an Exportar Excel button that downloads the full workbook (summary sheet + one sheet per section) from /api/accounting/export/workbook/?year=.

admin-accounting-list-error-retry.name: Admin Accounting Lists — Load Error & Retry
admin-accounting-list-error-retry.description: When a GET /api/accounting/<entity>/ (or dashboard/, change-logs/, settings/) fails, the page replaces the table/summary with AccountingErrorState (data-testid=accounting-error-retry): a Spanish danger alert plus a Reintentar button that re-fires the page's load function. CRUD errors keep using toasts and never hide the table. Mirrors admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.

admin-accounting-empty-state-cta.name: Admin Accounting Lists — Empty State CTA
admin-accounting-empty-state-cta.description: With zero records, accounting lists render BaseEmptyState with a primary 'Nuevo <entidad>' action that opens the create modal; with active filters and zero matches the action becomes 'Limpiar filtros' and resets the filter panel.

admin-proposal-discount-offer-send.name: Admin Proposal Discount Offer Send
admin-proposal-discount-offer-send.description: From /panel/proposals/:id/edit the seller opens the actions menu and picks 'Enviar oferta de descuento' — only shown when discount_percent > 0 and the client has an email. A modal renders the server-side email preview (POST /api/proposals/:id/email-preview/, template proposal_urgency); confirming sends the offer (POST /api/proposals/:id/discount-offer/send/ → ProposalEmailService.send_urgency_email force=True) and shows a success toast. Never auto-sent.

platform-password-reset.name: Platform Password Reset
platform-password-reset.description: Client recovers access from /platform/login → 'Olvidé mi contraseña': requests a reset code (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/request/), enters the 6-digit code (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/verify-code/) and sets a new password (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/confirm/), then returns to login. Public platform pages: forgot-password, verify-code, reset-password.

admin-client-first-login-notification.name: Admin Client First-Login Notification
admin-client-first-login-notification.description: When a platform client sets their password and logs in for the first time (POST /api/accounts/verify/, only when was_onboarded was False), client_flow_notifications fires a team milestone alert: an in-app notification to the project admins plus an email to the notification recipients. Best-effort; never blocks onboarding.
admin-client-first-login-notification.knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope, consistent with the other system-triggered flows; may be asserted as a branch of platform-verify-onboarding.

admin-client-email-validated-notificatio.name: Admin Client Email-Validated Notification
admin-client-email-validated-notificatio.description: When a client confirms their email OTP from the documents portal (POST /api/accounts/email/verify/confirm/), client_flow_notifications fires a team milestone alert (in-app to project admins + email to recipients). Best-effort; already-verified confirmations do not re-notify.
admin-client-email-validated-notificatio.knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope; may be asserted as a branch of platform-client-email-validation.

admin-client-document-signed-notificatio.name: Admin Client Document-Signed Notification
admin-client-document-signed-notificatio.description: When a client click-to-accept signs a document (POST /api/accounts/documents/:uuid/sign/), notify_team_document_signed_task fires a team milestone alert (in-app to project admins + email) and the client receives a signature-confirmation email. Best-effort; idempotent re-signs do not re-notify.
admin-client-document-signed-notificatio.knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope; may be asserted as a branch of platform-client-document-sign.

admin-linkedin-module.name: Admin LinkedIn Content Module
admin-linkedin-module.description: Admin manages freeform LinkedIn posts at /panel/linkedin (sidebar section ProjectApp content): connection card shows OAuth status (connect/reconnect popup, token expiry date via GET /api/linkedin/status/), posts list from GET /api/linkedin/posts/ with status chips (Borrador/Programado/Publicado/Fallido), create/edit modal (commentary max 3000, optional image, optional schedule datetime) posting to /api/linkedin/posts/create/ | :id/update/, publish-now with confirm via POST /api/linkedin/posts/:id/publish/ (502 error surfaces inline), delete with confirm via /api/linkedin/posts/:id/delete/. Scheduled posts are published by Huey (ETA + minute sweep) server-side.
knownGaps: Scheduled auto-publish is a server-side Huey task — covered by backend tests, not browser E2E

admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.name: Admin Diagnostic List — Load Error & Retry
admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.description: When GET /api/diagnostics/ fails, the list page shows a dedicated error state (data-testid=diagnostics-error-state) with the normalized Spanish error message and a 'Reintentar' button that re-fires the fetch; an error notification is also raised via usePanelNotify. Distinct from the empty state. Covered by e2e/admin/admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.spec.js.

admin-diagnostic-bulk-actions.name: Admin Diagnostic Bulk Actions
admin-diagnostic-bulk-actions.description: Admin selects diagnostics via row/header checkboxes in /panel/diagnostics; a batch bar appears with 'Finalizar aceptados' and 'Eliminar' (confirm modal), calling POST /api/diagnostics/bulk-action/ with {ids, action} and refreshing the list with a result notification. Covered by e2e/admin/admin-diagnostic-bulk-actions.spec.js.

admin-proposal-section-dirty-guard.name: Admin Proposal Section Dirty Guard
admin-proposal-section-dirty-guard.description: Unsaved-changes protection in the proposal section editor: editing a section shows a "Sin guardar" badge; collapsing a dirty section, navigating away, reloading or hitting the panel refresh button asks for confirmation before discarding edits.

admin-proposal-section-add-delete.name: Admin Proposal Section Add/Delete
admin-proposal-section-add-delete.description: Admin adds a missing section type from the "Agregar sección" modal (seeded server-side from language defaults via POST /api/proposals/:id/sections/create/) and deletes sections via the per-row trash action (DELETE /api/proposals/sections/:id/delete/), including the backend guard for functional requirements with a confirmed calculator selection.

admin-accounting-statements.name: Admin Accounting — Credit Card Statements
admin-accounting-statements.description: Superuser reviews the monthly credit-card statement ledger at /panel/accounting/statements: backend-driven year options (from the catalog's statements_since; months before it show 'No aplica') + card filters over a 12-month grid (Procesado/Borrador/Pendiente chips per card), inline statement detail (totals stat cards, category bars, transactions table flagging unidentified lines, 'Documento del extracto' PDF block with upload/view/replace/delete), finalize with forced-close confirm on total mismatch (POST /api/accounting/statements/:id/finalize/), reopen, delete, header edit modal and manual add-transaction on drafts, per-line delete on drafts, and single-click inline editing of fecha/descripcion/comercio/categoria/cuota/valor directly in the table (dashed underline + hover pencil as the affordance): comercio is a combobox over the learned merchant catalog that offers to remember the alias afterwards (POST /api/accounting/merchant-aliases/learn/) and can carry its default category, cuota is captured as a structured number/total pair, and negative amounts (refunds) edit inline keeping their sign. Editing a processed statement is allowed through a reopen-and-edit confirmation, since the backend keeps refusing writes on non-draft statements. Also: the per-line modal covering fecha, descripcion, comercio, categoria, cuota, valor and notas, and a 'Copiar prompt' button for the MCP chat kick-off. The collapsible 'Comercios aprendidos' table below the detail carries the same single-click inline editing over texto a mapear / comercio / categoria (PATCH /api/accounting/merchant-aliases/:id/update/, which re-normalizes the descriptor and rejects one already owned by another alias) plus per-row delete. Statements are normally created from the claude.ai chat via the accounting MCP connector (create_statement).

admin-accounting-card-catalog.name: Admin Accounting — Credit Card Catalog
admin-accounting-card-catalog.description: Superuser manages the CreditCard catalog from the 'Catálogo de tarjetas' section at /panel/accounting/settings: per-row name, cupo (credit_limit), 'extractos desde' month and active toggle, with per-row save (POST /api/accounting/credit-cards/create/ or PATCH .../update/) and delete with confirm (DELETE .../delete/ returns credit_card_referenced when snapshots/statements reference the name — deactivate instead). The catalog feeds the Tarjetas form dropdown, the server-side debt computation (cupo − disponible) and the Extractos year/month range; changes are audited as the credit_card entity.

admin-hour-packages-view-modes.name: Admin Hour Packages — View Modes
admin-hour-packages-view-modes.description: Admin switches the hour-package catalog between Tabla, Tarjetas (card grid) and Comparativa (pricing tiers highlighting 'Mejor tarifa') via a BaseSegmented control; the initial mode comes from GET /api/hour-packages/admin/settings/ (default_view_mode).

admin-hour-packages-config.name: Admin Hour Packages — Configuración
admin-hour-packages-config.description: Admin opens the Configuración section of /panel/hour-packages: edits the per-nationality base hourly rates (COL/EXT/USA) and saves — PATCH /api/hour-packages/admin/settings/update/ propagates the rate to every package of that nationality and the catalog reflects it; invalid rates (<= 0) are rejected client-side and a server failure surfaces an error toast. Also saves the default view mode and restores one nationality's catalog to the canonical DEFAULT_PACKAGES ladder behind a ConfirmModal (POST /api/hour-packages/admin/restore-defaults/, destructive replace; restore also resets that nationality's base rate).

admin-clients-config-tab.name: Admin Clients — Configuraciones Tab
admin-clients-config-tab.description: Admin activates the trailing 'Configuraciones' pill in the clients status-tab row: the list area swaps to the shared ViewSettingsPanel with the client saved-filter-tabs reset (ConfirmModal + POST accounts/saved-filter-tabs/reset/ with view=client, tabs reload on success) and a link to /panel/defaults.

admin-proposals-config-tab.name: Admin Proposals — Configuraciones Tab
admin-proposals-config-tab.description: Admin activates the fixed trailing 'Configuraciones' tab of the proposals filter-tab bar (right-aligned on desktop, select option on mobile): the list swaps to the shared ViewSettingsPanel with the proposal saved-filter-tabs reset (view=proposal) and a link to /panel/proposals/defaults. Selecting any filter tab closes the panel.

proposal-schedule-followup-reminder.name: Proposal Schedule Follow-up Reminder
proposal-schedule-followup-reminder.description: After rejecting with "not the right time", the client clicks the reminder CTA which POSTs proposals/:uuid/schedule-followup/ and flips to a scheduled-confirmation state.

admin-proposal-prompt.name: Admin Proposal Prompt Tab
admin-proposal-prompt.description: Admin copies, edits, downloads and resets the commercial and technical proposal-generation prompts from the Prompt tab (localStorage-persisted; parallel of admin-diagnostic-prompt).
admin-proposal-prompt.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-23 (round 7): action bar, edit->save revealing the reset action, cancel discarding the draft.

admin-proposal-dev-checklist.name: Admin Proposal Dev Checklist Tab
admin-proposal-dev-checklist.description: Admin generates, copies and downloads the Markdown developer checklist from the Desarrollo tab of an accepted proposal (client-side markdown build).
knownGaps: No spec yet (2026-07 audit): tab only appears for accepted proposals; refresh/copy/download untested.

admin-linktrees.name: Admin Linktrees
admin-linktrees.description: Admin creates linktrees (internal name + unique handle, personal/company kind), edits identity, tiered buttons (1 primary, <=1 featured, pairs of 2, <=6 rows), PWA block and vCard data from /panel/linktrees, and assigns a linktree as QR card destination. Public URL is /lk/@handle; the backend rejects handle collisions, reserved handles and tier cardinality violations.

public-linktree-view.name: Public Linktree View
public-linktree-view.description: Visitor opens /lk/@handle (via the QR short link redirect or directly) and sees the brand-fixed linktree page: identity block per kind, tiered buttons in order (pairs side by side, pending buttons dashed and inert), PWA install block and footer tagline. Unknown or inactive handles show the not-available state.
